glossary.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’)
glossary.ὑφέντες: ὑφίημι — let down, lower; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having lowered’
glossary.ὑψοῦ: ὑψοῦ — on high, high up; adv.
glossary.ὠκεανὸν: Ὠκεανός — Oceanus, the river encircling the earth; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὠκυμορώτατος: ὠκύμορος — swift to one’s doom, short-lived; superlative ὠκυμορώτατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’the most short-lived’
glossary.ὠκυπόροισι: ὠκυπόρος — swift-going, swift-sailing; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις; a two-ending adjective), agreeing with νηυσί
glossary.ὠκύμορος: ὠκύμορος — swift to one’s doom, short-lived (ὠκύς + μόρος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὠμοθέτησαν: ὠμοθετέω — lay raw pieces (on the burning offering) (ὠμός ’raw’ + τίθημι ’place’); aor. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.ὤπτησάν: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. 3 pl. act., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
glossary.ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
glossary.ῥέξαι: ῥέζω — do, perform, esp. offer sacrifice; aor. inf. act.: ’to offer’ · also ’do, act’; aor. inf. act. (ὧδε δὲ ῥέξαι ’to do thus’)
glossary.ῥηγμῖνι: ῥηγμίς — the line of breaking surf, the beach at the waterline (ῥήγνυμι ’break’); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., epithet of Dawn
glossary.αἰγλήεντος: αἰγλήεις — gleaming, radiant; masc. gen. sg., epic -ήεις adjective (epithet of Olympus)
glossary.αἰνότατε: αἰνός — dread, terrible; superl. masc. voc. sg. αἰνότατε: ’most dread one’, in address
glossary.αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly; adv. from αἰνός, intensifying a verb of feeling: αἰνῶς δείδοικα ’I am terribly afraid’
glossary.αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl.: ’they’; αἳ μέν … αἳ δέ ’some … others’
glossary.αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a dative: ’to her herself’ (αὐτῇ περ νοεούσῃ ’even though she herself understands’)
glossary.αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
glossary.βηλοῦ: βηλός — threshold; masc. gen. sg., gen. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the threshold’
glossary.βουλάς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βουλεύσαντε: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; aor. part. masc. nom. dual: ’the two having planned’
glossary.βουλὰς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βοῶπις: βοῶπις — ox-eyed, with the eyes of a cow; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Hera
glossary.γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. (ἁλίοιο γέροντος ’of the old man of the sea’)
glossary.γλυκὺ: γλυκύς — sweet; neut. acc. sg.: ’sweet’ (γλυκὺ νέκταρ)
glossary.γλυκὺς: γλυκύς — sweet; masc. nom. sg., with ὕπνος: ’sweet’
glossary.δέος: δέος — fear, dread; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.δέπας: δέπας — cup, drinking-cup; neut. acc. sg. (nom. identical)
glossary.δαιμονίη: δαιμόνιος — strange, puzzling, uncanny; fem. voc. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α), reproachful address: ’strange one’
glossary.δείδοικα: δείδω — fear; perf. 1 sg. with present sense, epic δείδοικα: ’I fear’
glossary.δεύτερον: δεύτερος — second; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a second time’
glossary.διέτμαγεν: διατμήγω — cut apart; aor. 2 pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= -ησαν), ’parted’; can agree with a dual subject
glossary.διί: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. dat. sg. (Διί, from the stem Δι-)
glossary.διείρεο: διείρομαι — question closely, ask all about; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted -εο (= Attic διείρου)
glossary.δικαζέμεν: δικάζω — judge, give judgement, decide; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic δικάζειν)
glossary.δολομῆτα: δολομήτης — of crafty counsel, wily; masc. voc. sg., epic -α: ’wily one’, in address
glossary.δυνήσομαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall be able’
glossary.δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
glossary.δὴν: δήν — for a long time, long; adv.
glossary.δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.εἰδέω: οἶδα — know; subj. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰδῶ), in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I may know’
glossary.εἰδήσειν: οἶδα — know; fut. inf. εἰδήσειν (fut. εἰδήσω), after ἐπιέλπεο: ’to be going to know’
glossary.εἰπεῖν: εἶπον (aor. of φημί/λέγω) — say, tell; aor. inf. act., completing τέτληκας: ’to speak out, to tell’
glossary.εἰσ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., elided (εἰσ’ = εἰσί): ’are’
glossary.εἴρετο: ἔρομαι (εἴρομαι) — ask, question; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἤρετο): ’asked’
glossary.εἴρομαι: ἔρομαι (εἴρομαι) — ask, question; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic: ’I ask’
glossary.εἴσεται: οἶδα — know; fut. 3 sg. mid. εἴσεται, epic: ’will know’
glossary.εὔκηλος: εὔκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεινομένην: θείνω — strike, beat; pres. part. pass. fem. acc. sg.: ’being struck’
glossary.θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
glossary.θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.θεσπεσίοιο: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, marvellous, divinely great; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= -ου)
glossary.θρόνου: θρόνος — chair, seat; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.θυμοῦ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κάθησο: κάθημαι — sit; pres. imper. 2 sg. κάθησο: ’sit!’
glossary.κάππεσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 1 sg. κάππεσον, with κατά assimilated to the next consonant (= κατέπεσον): ’I fell down’
glossary.καθάπτεσθαι: καθάπτομαι — accost, address (+ acc., with words); pres. inf. mid., standing for an imperative: ’address him’
glossary.καθέζετ: καθέζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., elided (καθέζετ’ = καθέζετο)
glossary.καθεῦδ: καθεύδω — sleep, lie asleep; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (καθεῦδ’ = καθεῦδε; Attic ἐκάθευδε)
glossary.καθῆστο: κάθημαι — sit; plpf. form 3 sg. καθῆστο with impf. sense (= ἐκάθητο): ’was sitting’
glossary.κακκείοντες: κατακείω — wish to lie down (desiderative of κεῖμαι); pres. part. masc. nom. pl., κακκείοντες = κατακείοντες
glossary.καλῇ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κατάνευσον: κατανεύω — nod assent to, grant by a nod; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’grant it!’
glossary.καταδύντα: καταδύω — go down, set; aor. part. masc. acc. sg. (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’)
glossary.καταδύντι: καταδύω — sink, set (of the sun); intrans. aor. part., masc. dat. sg., temporal: ’as it sank’
glossary.κατανεύσομαι: κατανεύω — nod assent, grant; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall nod assent’
glossary.κατανεύσω: κατανεύω — nod assent, grant; aor. subj. 1 sg. (short vowel) or fut., after κεν: ’I nod assent to’
glossary.κατανεῦσαι: κατανεύω — nod assent, promise; aor. inf. act.
glossary.κερτομίοισι: κερτόμιος — taunting, mocking; adj. used as noun, dat. pl., epic -οισι: ’with taunts’
glossary.κεφαλῇ: κεφαλή — head; fem. dat. sg., of the means: ’with a (nod of the) head’
glossary.κλυτοτέχνης: κλυτοτέχνης — famed for skill, renowned craftsman; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Hephaestus
glossary.κοιμᾶθ: κοιμάομαι — sleep, lie down to rest; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided and unaugmented (κοιμᾶθ’ = κοιμᾶτο, Attic ἐκοιμᾶτο): ’used to sleep’
glossary.κολῳὸν: κολῳός — brawl, din, wrangling; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐλαύνετον: ’a brawl’
glossary.κομίσαντο: κομίζω — take care of, tend; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκομίσαντο): ’took in and tended’
glossary.κρατὸς: κάρη — head; gen. sg. κρατός, from the by-form κράς, gen. of separation: ’from his head’
glossary.κρητῆρος: κρατήρ — mixing bowl; masc. gen. sg., epic κρητήρ (= Attic κρατήρ)
glossary.κρονίδη: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus, patronymic/epithet of Zeus; voc. sg.
glossary.κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
glossary.κρυπτάδια: κρυπτάδιος — secret, hidden; neut. acc. pl. used as a noun: ’secret things’
glossary.κυανέῃσιν: κυάνεος — dark, dark-blue; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.κύπελλον: κύπελλον — cup, goblet; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λήθω: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); pres. 1 sg., epic λήθω: ’I escape (your notice)’
glossary.λήμνῳ: Λῆμνος — Lemnos, an island of the northern Aegean; fem. dat. sg., place where, after ἐν
glossary.λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
glossary.λαμπρὸν: λαμπρός — bright, shining; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.λευκωλένῳ: λευκώλενος — white-armed; two-ending adj., dat. sg. (fem. with a woman’s name), epithet of women
glossary.λοίγια: λοίγιος — ruinous, deadly; neut. nom./acc. pl. (λοίγια ἔργα ’ruinous deeds’)
glossary.μάχῃ: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.μέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg. μέ, accented because an enclitic follows: ’me’
glossary.μέγιστον: μέγας — great; superl. neut. nom. sg.: ’greatest’
glossary.μέλλει: μέλλω — be about to, be destined, be likely (+ inf.); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.μακάρεσσι: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (epithet of the gods); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
glossary.μαλακοῖσιν: μαλακός — soft, gentle; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.μειδήσασα: μειδάω — smile; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having smiled’
glossary.μελήσεται: μέλω — be a care to (+ dat.); fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will be a care, will concern’
glossary.μεμαῶτα: μέμονα — be eager, be minded, strive; perf. part. (pres. sense) masc. acc. sg. μεμαώς, μεμαῶτα: ’eager, straining’
glossary.μετάλλα: μεταλλάω — inquire, ask after; pres. imper. 2 sg., uncontracted -αε → -α: ’ask!’
glossary.μεταλλῶ: μεταλλάω — inquire, ask after; pres. 1 sg., contracted: ’I inquire’
glossary.μεῖναι: μένω — stay, wait; aor. inf., complementing ἔτλη: ’to stand firm, to wait for’
glossary.μουσάων: Μοῦσα — Muse; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.μύθους: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
glossary.νέκταρ: νέκταρ — nectar, the gods’ drink; neut. acc. sg. (nom. identical)
glossary.νεικείῃσι: νεικέω — quarrel with, rebuke; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic νεικῇ), after ὄφρα μή: ’lest he rebuke’
glossary.νεικεῖ: νεικέω — quarrel with, rebuke; pres. 3 sg., contracted (epic νεικέει): ’she quarrels with’
glossary.νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
glossary.νεῦσε: νεύω — nod; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔνευσε)
glossary.νημερτὲς: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’unerringly, truly’
glossary.νικᾷ: νικάω — conquer, prevail; pres. 3 sg., contracted (= νικᾷ from epic νικάει)
glossary.νοήσῃ: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή (fear): ’lest she notice’
glossary.νοήσῃς: νοέω — perceive, think of; aor. subj. 2 sg., indefinite after ὅττι: ’whatever you have in mind’
glossary.νοεούσῃ: νοέω — perceive, be aware; pres. part. fem. dat. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νοούσῃ): ’being aware’
glossary.νόσφιν: νόσφιν — apart, far off, away; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’apart from, without’
glossary.οἰνοχόει: οἰνοχοέω — pour wine, serve wine; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ᾠνοχόει)
glossary.οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household; masc. acc. sg., with the suffix -δε: οἶκον δέ ’homeward, to his house’
glossary.οὐρανίωνες: Οὐρανίων — child of Uranus (Heaven) or dweller in heaven, sense disputed; masc. nom. pl., epic: θεοὶ Οὐρανίωνες ’the gods, the children of Heaven’
glossary.οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
glossary.παλινάγρετον: παλινάγρετος — that can be taken back, revocable; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.παράφημι: παράφημι — advise, exhort (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg.: ’I advise’
glossary.παρέζετο: παρέζομαι — sit beside; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’sat beside’
glossary.παρείπῃ: παρεῖπον — talk over, win over, persuade (+ acc.); aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή (fear): ’lest she win you over’
glossary.πεποίθῃς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα be convinced, trust; perf. subj. 2 sg., purpose: ’that you may be convinced’
glossary.περικαλλέος: περικαλλής — very beautiful; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.περικλυτὸς: περικλυτός — very famous, far-famed; masc. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form), epithet of Hephaestus
glossary.πεσόντα: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having fallen’
glossary.ποίησεν: ποιέω — make, build; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐποίησεν)
glossary.ποδὸς: πούς — foot; masc. gen. sg., gen. of the part seized: ’by the foot’
glossary.ποιπνύοντα: ποιπνύω — bustle about, hurry busily; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’bustling’
glossary.πολέας: πολύς — much, many; masc./fem. acc. pl., epic πολέας (= Attic πολλούς)
glossary.ποῖον: ποῖος — of what kind, what sort of; masc. acc. sg., interrogative: ’what sort of (word)?’
glossary.πραπίδεσσι: πραπίδες — wits, mind, understanding; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
glossary.πρόπαν: πρόπας — all through, the whole; neut. acc. sg., of time (πρόπαν ἦμαρ ’all day long’)
glossary.πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’ · also predicate, ’earlier-born, elder’ (ὁ δ’ ἅμα πρότερος ’and he was the elder’)
glossary.πρῆξαι: πρήσσω (Attic πράσσω) — accomplish, achieve, effect; aor. inf. act.
glossary.σίντιες: Σίντιες — the Sintians, a people of Lemnos; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.στυφελίξαι: στυφελίζω — shake, dislodge by force, hurl; aor. inf. act., after ἐθέλῃσιν: ’to dislodge’
glossary.συμφράσσατο: συμφράζομαι — plan together with, contrive jointly (+ dat. of person, + acc. of the plan); aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.σφοῦ: σφός — their own, his own (possessive adj. of the 3rd person); masc. gen. sg. σφοῦ, agreeing with πατρός
glossary.σφὼ: σύ — you; dual nom. σφώ: ’you two’
glossary.τάδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (τάδ’ = τάδε): ’these things’ · also with a noun: ’these’ (τάδ’ ἔργα)
glossary.τέκμωρ: τέκμωρ — a fixed mark, sign, pledge; neut. nom. sg. (indecl.)
glossary.τέτλαθι: τλάω — endure, bear; perf. imper. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’endure!’
glossary.ταράξῃ: ταράσσω — stir up, throw into confusion; aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα μή, with σύν in tmesis: ’lest he upset’
glossary.τελέσσω: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic τελέσω), after ὄφρα: ’until I accomplish’
glossary.τεταγὼν: τεταγών — seizing; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated, found only in this participle (+ gen.): ’having seized’
glossary.τιμήσῃς: τιμάω — honour; aor. subj. 2 sg., after ὡς: ’that you will honour’
glossary.τοῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom. sg., elided (τοῦτ’ = τοῦτο): ’this’
glossary.φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.φέρειν: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. inf.
glossary.φέρτατός: φέρτατος — best, mightiest; superl. of φέρτερος, masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
glossary.φερόμην: φέρω — carry; impf. pass. 1 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐφερόμην): ’I was carried, I drifted’
glossary.φράζεαι: φράζομαι — consider, plan, devise; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic φράζῃ)
glossary.φρονέοντα: φρονέω — think, plan; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦντα)
glossary.χαλεποί: χαλεπός — harsh, hard to deal with; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χαῖται: χαίτη — hair of the head, mane; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.χερείονα: χερείων (Attic χείρων) — worse, inferior; neut. nom. pl., comparative of κακός, with τά: ’the worse things’
glossary.χραίσμωσιν: χραισμέω — avail, help (+ dat.); aor. subj. 3 pl., after μὴ οὐ (fear): ’lest they fail to help’
glossary.χρυσόθρονος: χρυσόθρονος — golden-throned; adj., fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses (an old alternative derives the second element from θρόνα ’embroidered flowers’)
glossary.ἀάπτους: ἄαπτος — meaning unknown (traditionally ’untouchable’ or ’irresistible’); fem. acc. pl., agreeing with χεῖρας
glossary.ἀγορεύειν: ἀγορεύω — speak (esp. in assembly); pres. inf.
glossary.ἀθανάτοιο: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀκέουσα: ἀκέων — silent, in silence; fem. nom. sg. ἀκέουσα: ’silent, in silence’
glossary.ἀκουέμεν: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀκούειν)
glossary.ἀλεξέμεναι: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend; inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀλέξειν): ’to defend’
glossary.ἀμβρόσιαι: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine, ambrosial; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμειβόμεναι: ἀμείβομαι — answer in turn, take turns; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.: ’answering one another’
glossary.ἀμφιγυήεις: ἀμφιγυήεις — epithet of Hephaestus, conventionally ’lame in both legs’ or ’strong in both arms’; sense disputed; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφικύπελλον: ἀμφικύπελλος — meaning disputed: usually ’double’ (a cup with a bowl at each end), also ’two-handled’; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δέπας
glossary.ἀνάσχεο: ἀνέχω — hold up; mid. endure, bear; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic ἀνάσχεο (= Attic ἀνάσχου): ’endure!’
glossary.ἀνέσταν: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 pl., root aorist, intrans. (= Attic ἀνέστησαν)
glossary.ἀναΐξας: ἀναΐσσω — start up suddenly, spring up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναβάς: ἀναβαίνω — go up, climb, mount; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνεκτά: ἀνεκτός — endurable, bearable; neut. nom. pl.: οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ἀνεκτά ’no longer bearable’
glossary.ἀντίοι: ἀντίος — facing, opposite, in front; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀντιφέρεσθαι: ἀντιφέρομαι — set oneself against, match oneself with (+ dat.); pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen.
glossary.ἀπατηλὸν: ἀπατηλός — deceitful, deceptive; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπόειπ: ἀπεῖπον — refuse, renounce, say no; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic ἀπόειπε (= Attic ἀπεῖπε), elided
glossary.ἀπόστιχε: ἀποστείχω — go away, depart; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’go away!’
glossary.ἀρήγειν: ἀρήγω — help, aid (+ dat.); pres. inf.
glossary.ἀργαλέος: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, grievous; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἀργυρόπεζα: ἀργυρόπεζα — silver-footed, epithet of Thetis; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀστεροπητής: ἀστεροπητής — lightener, wielder of lightning; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ἀστεροπητὴς: ἀστεροπητής — lightener, wielder of lightning; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.ἀτελεύτητον: ἀτελεύτητος — unfulfilled, not brought to an end; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀτιμοτάτη: ἄτιμος — dishonoured, without honour; superl. ἀτιμότατος, fem. nom. sg.: ’most dishonoured’
glossary.ἀφύσσων: ἀφύσσω — draw (liquid), ladle out; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’drawing’
glossary.ἀχιλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
glossary.ἁλίοιο: ἅλιος — of the sea, belonging to the sea; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), epithet of γέρων ’the old man of the sea’
glossary.ἄειδον: ἀείδω — sing; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic ἄειδον (= Attic ᾖδον)
glossary.ἄλλοισι: ἄλλος — other; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἄλλοτ: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at other times; adv., elided (ἄλλοτ’); καὶ ἄλλοτ’ ’at another time too’
glossary.ἄσβεστος: ἄσβεστος — unquenchable, unceasing; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἅσσ: ὅστις (neut. pl. ἅσσα, epic = Attic ἅττα) — whoever, whatever; elided ἅσσ’ = ἅσσα: ’whatever things’
glossary.ἆλτο: ἅλλομαι — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. mid., athematic, epic (= Attic ἥλατο): ’sprang’
glossary.ἐθέλωμι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 1 sg., epic -μι (= Attic ἐθέλω): ’I wish’
glossary.ἐθέλῃσθα: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic ending -ῃσθα (= Attic ἐθέλῃς)
glossary.ἐλέλιξεν: ἐλελίζω — shake, make quake; aor. 3 sg.: ’shook’
glossary.ἐλαύνετον: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive on, stir up; pres. 2 dual: ’you two drive’
glossary.ἐμέθεν: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμέθεν (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’of me’
glossary.ἐμή: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. voc. sg. (= nom. in form), agreeing with μῆτερ: ’my (mother)’
glossary.ἐμοὺς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐμπεφυυῖα: ἐμφύω — grow in, cling to; perf. part. fem. nom. sg., intrans., epic ἐμπεφυυῖα (= Attic ἐμπεφυκυῖα): ’clinging’
glossary.ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐναντίον: ἐναντίος — opposite; neut. acc. sg. as adv./prep. + gen.: ’in front of, before’
glossary.ἐνδέξια: ἐνδέξιος — to the right; neut. acc. pl. as adv.: ’rightwards, towards the right’
glossary.ἐνῆεν: ἔνειμι — be in, be present in; impf. 3 sg., epic ἐνῆεν (= Attic ἐνῆν): ’was in (him)’
glossary.ἐνῶρτο: ἐνόρνυμι — rouse in; mid. arise among; aor. 3 sg. mid., ἐνῶρτο (ἐν + ὦρτο): ’arose among’
glossary.ἐούσῃ: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. dat. sg., epic ἐούσῃ (= Attic οὔσῃ)
glossary.ἐοῦσαν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic οὖσαν)
glossary.ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
glossary.ἐπίηρα: ἐπίηρα — pleasing service, gratification; neut. pl. in ἐπίηρα φέρειν ’to bring what pleases, to oblige’ (+ dat.); origin disputed
glossary.ἐπερρώσαντο: ἐπιρρώομαι — stream on, rush upon; aor. 3 pl. mid., ἐπερρώσαντο: ’streamed forward’
glossary.ἐπερχόμενον: ἐπέρχομαι — come on, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιέλπεο: ἐπιέλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted -εο (= Attic ἐπιέλπου): μὴ … ἐπιέλπεο ’do not expect’
glossary.ἐπιγνάμψασα: ἐπιγνάμπτω — bend, curb, bend to; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having curbed’
glossary.ἐπιεικὲς: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., used impersonally with ἐστί
glossary.ἐπιπείθεο: ἐπιπείθομαι — obey (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic ἐπιπείθου)
glossary.ἐρέθῃσιν: ἐρέθω — provoke, irritate; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν, after ὅτ’ ἄν: ’whenever she provokes’
glossary.ἐριδαίνετον: ἐριδαίνω (ἐρίζω) — quarrel, contend; pres. 2 dual: ’you two quarrel’
glossary.ἐσθλῆς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, fine; fem. gen. sg., with δαιτός
glossary.ἐτήτυμον: ἐτήτυμος — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
glossary.ἐφήσεις: ἐφίημι — send upon, set on; fut. 2 sg., + acc. + inf.: ’you will make (me) …’
glossary.ἐφείω: ἐφίημι — send upon, lay on; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic ἐφείω (= Attic ἐφῶ); χεῖρας ἐφιέναι ’lay hands on’
glossary.ἐχθοδοπῆσαι: ἐχθοδοπέω — be at odds with, quarrel with (+ dat.); aor. inf. act.
glossary.ἑδέων: ἕδος — seat, chair; neut. gen. pl., uncontracted (= ἑδῶν)
glossary.ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’his own’
glossary.ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
glossary.ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
glossary.ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
glossary.ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
glossary.ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα)
glossary.ἔσεαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 2 sg., epic ἔσεαι (= Attic ἔσῃ): ’you will be’
glossary.ἔσοντ: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 pl., epic ἔσονται, elided (ἔσοντ’): ’will be’
glossary.ἔσταν: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 pl., root aorist, intrans., epic (= Attic ἔστησαν): ’stood’
glossary.ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
glossary.ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’
glossary.ἔχετ: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. cling, hold on; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἔχετ’ = ἔχετο): ’kept holding on’
glossary.ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’
glossary.ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἕνεκα: ἕνεκα — on account of, for the sake of; prep. + gen.
glossary.ἠέλιον: ἥλιος — sun; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted ἠέλιον (= Attic ἥλιον)
glossary.ἠγνοίησεν: ἀγνοιέω (Attic ἀγνοέω) — fail to recognize, not know; aor. 3 sg. act., negated by οὐδέ: ’did not fail to recognize’
glossary.ἠελίοιο: ἥλιος — sun; masc. gen. sg., epic ἠελίοιο (= Attic ἡλίου)
glossary.ἠελίῳ: ἥλιος — sun; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέλιος (= Attic ἥλιος)
glossary.ἤϊ: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic ἤϊε, elided (ἤϊ’ = ἤϊε; Attic ᾔει): ’went’
glossary.ἥρῃ: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. dat. sg. Ἥρῃ (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα)
glossary.ἥφαιστον: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἥφαιστος: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; nom. sg.
glossary.ἥψατο: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, take hold of (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἦδος: ἦδος — pleasure, delight; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’ · also elided ἦρχον, impf. 3 pl., + gen.: ’were leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀσκάλαφος καὶ Ἰάλμενος) · also elided ἦρχε, impf. 3 sg., + gen.: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχ’ Ἀγκαίοιο πάϊς)
glossary.ἧχι: ἧχι — where; epic relative adv. (= Attic οὗ)
glossary.ἰδοῦσ: ὁράω — see; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἰδοῦσ’ = ἰδοῦσα; aor. stem ἰδ-): ’having seen’
glossary.ἰδυίῃσι: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. dat. pl., epic ἰδυίῃσι (= Attic εἰδυίαις): ’skilful’
glossary.ἰόνθ: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., ἰόντα elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἰόνθ’): ’coming’
glossary.ἱκάνοι: ἱκάνω — come, reach, come upon (= ἱκνέομαι); pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’might come upon’
glossary.ἵλαος: ἵλαος — gracious, propitious; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἵλεως)
glossary.ὀΐεαι: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted ὀΐεαι (= Attic οἴει): ’you suppose’
glossary.ὀλέσῃς: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. subj. 2 sg. (ὀλέσσω, Attic ὀλέσω): ’you destroy’
glossary.ὀλίγος: ὀλίγος — little, small, puny; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀλύμπου: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, the mountain home of the gods; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ὀλύμπῳ: Ὄλυμπος (epic Οὔλυμπος) — Olympus, mountain home of the gods; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ὀνειδείοις: ὀνείδειος — abusive, reproachful; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
glossary.ὀπὶ: ὄψ — voice; fem. dat. sg. (ὀπὶ καλῇ ’with a beautiful voice’)
glossary.ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
glossary.ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
glossary.ὄχθησαν: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. 3 pl.: ’were vexed’
glossary.ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’
glossary.ὑπόσχεο: ὑπίσχομαι — promise, undertake; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., ὑπόσχεο (= Attic ὑπόσχου): ’promise!’
glossary.ῥῖψε: ῥίπτω — throw, hurl; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔρριψε)
glossary.αἱρήσειν: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; fut. inf. act.: ’to take’ (a city)
glossary.αἱρείτω: αἱρέω — take, seize; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it seize’
glossary.βάλετο: βάλλω — throw, cast; mid. throw on oneself, sling; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐβάλετο): ’slung (round himself)’
glossary.βάλλετο: βάλλω — throw, cast; mid. throw on oneself, sling; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐβάλλετο): ’he slung on’ (περὶ … βάλλετο, περί in tmesis)
glossary.βάσκ: βάσκω — go (lengthened form of βαίνω); pres. imper. 2 sg. βάσκε, elided (βάσκ’): ’go!’
glossary.βουλήν: βουλή — plan, counsel, decision; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βουληφόρον: βουληφόρος — counsel-bearing, giving counsel; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γερόντων: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.δίῳ: δῖος — bright, noble, divine (epic epithet); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δαΐφρονος: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’took up (for himself)’
glossary.εἶδός: εἶδος — form, appearance, beauty; neut. acc. sg.; accented before enclitic τε
glossary.εὐρυάγυιαν: εὐρυάγυιος — wide-streeted (of a city); fem. acc. sg. εὐρυάγυιαν, agreeing with πόλιν (εὐρύς + ἄγυια ’street’)
glossary.εὕδοντ: εὕδω — sleep; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (εὕδοντ’ = εὕδοντα)
glossary.εὗδον: εὕδω — sleep; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (Attic ηὗδον, ἐκάθευδον): ’they slept’ · also impf. 1 sg. (same form)
glossary.ζηνὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus; dat. sg., epic stem Ζην- (Ζηνί = Διί)
glossary.θέμις: θέμις — custom, what is right, established usage; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θήσειν: τίθημι — put, place, make; fut. inf. θήσειν: ’to put, lay’ (ἐπ’ … θήσειν, ἐπί in tmesis, ’to lay upon’)
glossary.θείη: θεῖος — divine, from the gods; fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α)
glossary.θεῖος: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεῖός: θεῖος — divine, from the gods; adj., masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.θωρήξομεν: θωρήσσω — arm (put on the corslet, θώρηξ); aor. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel, with αἴ κεν (or fut. indic.): ’we shall arm’
glossary.θωρῆξαί: θωρήσσω — arm (put on the corslet, θώρηξ); aor. inf. act.: ’to arm’; accent from the following enclitic
glossary.κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ (κάρη κομόωντας ’long-haired’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’head’ (κάρη ὤμοισιν ἐπείη ’may the head be on the shoulders’)
glossary.κέλευε: κελεύω — command, order; pres. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.κέλευσε: κελεύω — order, command; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκέλευσε)
glossary.κέχυθ: χέω — pour, shed; epic past 3 sg., elided κέχυθ’ (form disputed; sense of κέχυτο), intrans.: ’was poured round, lay spread’
glossary.κήδεται: κήδω — trouble; mid. care for, be concerned for; pres. 3 sg. mid., + gen.: ’cares for’
glossary.κίχανεν: κιχάνω — reach, come upon, find; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκίχανεν), ν-movable: ’came upon, found’
glossary.καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κείνῳ: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἤματι: ’on that day’
glossary.κελεύσω: κελεύω — urge, command, bid; fut. 1 sg. (or short-vowel aor. subj.): ’I shall bid’
glossary.κηρύκεσσι: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κήρυξι)
glossary.κηρύσσειν: κηρύσσω — proclaim, summon by herald; pres. inf.
glossary.κλῦτε: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic: ’hear!’
glossary.κομόωντας: κομάω — wear one’s hair long; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic diectasis (= Attic κομῶντας)
glossary.κρατερὰς: κρατερός — strong, mighty, stubborn; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.λήθη: λήθη — forgetfulness, oblivion; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λιγυφθόγγοισι: λιγύφθογγος — clear-voiced; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λιπαροῖσιν: λιπαρός — sleek, glistening, glossy (as skin rubbed with oil); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.μέγεθός: μέγεθος — size, stature; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.μέδοντες: μέδων — ruler, lord (part. of μέδω ’rule over’, used as noun); masc. voc. pl., address · also masc. nom. pl., subject: ἡγήτορες ἠδὲ μέδοντες ’leaders and rulers’
glossary.μέμηλε: μέλω — be a care to (+ dat.); perf. 3 sg. with pres. force, epic (Attic μεμέληκε): ’is a care’
glossary.μήδετο: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was devising, planned’
glossary.μεγαθύμων: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.μελίφρων: μελίφρων — heart-sweetening, soothing (μέλι ’honey’ + φρήν); masc. nom. sg., epithet of sleep
glossary.μερμήριζε: μερμηρίζω — ponder anxiously, be in doubt; impf. 3 sg.: ’pondered’
glossary.μηδέ: μηδέ — and not, nor; neg. conj., used with an imperative to forbid: ’and let not’
glossary.νήδυμος: νήδυμος — sweet, refreshing (stock epithet of sleep; formation disputed, sometimes linked by folk-etymology to ἡδύς); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νήπιος: νήπιος — infant, still a child, witless; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νεστορέῃ: Νεστόρειος — of Nestor, Nestor’s; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic -έῃ (= Attic -έᾳ)
glossary.νηγάτεον: νηγάτεος — newly made, freshly woven (exact sense uncertain); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νηληΐῳ: Νηλήϊος — of Neleus, Neleian (Nestor’s father); masc. dat. sg.: ’Neleus’ son’ (with υἷι)
glossary.νοσφιζοίμεθα: νοσφίζω — turn away, keep apart; mid. turn away from, withdraw; pres. opt. 1 pl. mid.: ’we should turn away (from it)’
glossary.νύκτα: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration, after διά: ’(through) the night’
glossary.ξύνες: συνίημι — understand, take heed; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic ξύν- (= σύν-): ’take heed!’
glossary.οὖλε: οὖλος — destructive, baneful (cf. ὄλλυμι ’destroy’); masc. voc. sg.: ’baneful (one)’
glossary.οὖλον: οὖλος — destructive, baneful (cf. ὄλλυμι ’destroy’); masc. acc. sg. · also οὖλος, ’whole, entire’ (Attic ὅλος), a different word
glossary.πέμψαι: πέμπω — send, convey; aor. inf. act.: ’to send’
glossary.παννύχιοι: παννύχιος — all night long; masc. nom. pl., with adverbial force: ’all night’
glossary.παννύχιον: παννύχιος — all night long; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνδρα (or neut. adverbial): ’all night’
glossary.πανσυδίῃ: πανσυδίη — in full force, with all one’s might (πᾶς + σεύω); fem. dat. sg. used adverbially
glossary.πατρώϊον: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, ancestral; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.πειρήσομαι: πειράω — try, make trial (of); fut. 1 sg. mid., epic (= Attic πειράσομαι), or hortatory aor. subj.: ’I shall try’
glossary.πολυκλήϊσι: πολυκλήϊς — with many oar-benches or thole-pins (sense disputed); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισι
glossary.ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.πριάμου: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.προσεβήσετο: προσβαίνω — go up to, step onto; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σετο (cf. Attic προσέβη): ’mounted, stepped onto’
glossary.προσεφώνεε: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg., augmented (προσ- + ἐ-φώνεε): ’was speaking to, addressed’
glossary.πυκινὴν: πυκινός — close-packed, dense; of counsel, shrewd; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πυλοιγενέος: Πυλοιγενής — born at Pylos, Pylos-born; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Nestor
glossary.πύλοιο: Πύλος — Pylos; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
glossary.στοναχάς: στοναχή — groan, sigh; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.συγκαλέσας: συγκαλέω — call together, summon; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having called together’
glossary.σῇσιν: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with φρεσί
glossary.τιμήσῃ: τιμάω — honour; aor. subj. 3 sg., in an indirect deliberation after ὡς: ’he should honour’
glossary.τρωσί: Τρώς — a Trojan; masc. dat. pl. (Τρῶες, Τρωσί): ’Trojans’
glossary.τῖ: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (τῖ’ = τῖε = ἔτιε): ’honoured’
glossary.υἷι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἷι (= Attic υἱεῖ)
glossary.φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι)
glossary.φαίνετο: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, seem; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφαίνετο)
glossary.φαῖμεν: φημί — say, declare; pres. opt. 1 pl., potential with κεν: ’we would say’
glossary.φράζονται: φράζομαι — consider, devise, plot; pres. mid. 3 pl.
glossary.φρεσί: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φρονέοντ: φρονέω — think, ponder; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (φρονέοντ’ = φρονέοντα), epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦντα)
glossary.φόως: φῶς (φάος) — light; neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φῶς)
glossary.φᾶρος: φᾶρος — large cloth, robe, web; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.φῆ: φημί — say, declare, assert; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφη): ’said, declared’
glossary.ψεῦδός: ψεῦδος — lie, falsehood; neut. nom./acc. sg.; accent from the following enclitic
glossary.ἀγορευέμεν: ἀγορεύω — speak, tell; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic -εύειν), used as an imperative: ’tell!’
glossary.ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
glossary.ἀμβροσίην: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (= Attic -αν), agreeing with νύκτα: ’immortal’
glossary.ἀμβρόσιος: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφέχυτ: ἀμφιχέω — pour around, envelop; aor. 3 sg. mid., 2nd aor. ἀμφέχυτο, elided (ἀμφέχυτ’): ’poured around, enveloped’
glossary.ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
glossary.ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
glossary.ἀνήῃ: ἀνίημι — let go, release; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ήῃ (= Attic ἀνῇ), with ἄν after εὖτε: ’lets go, releases’
glossary.ἀνῆκεν: ἀνίημι — let go, release; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’let go, released’
glossary.ἀποπτάμενος: ἀποπέτομαι — fly away; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg. (2nd aor. ἀπεπτάμην): ’having flown away’
glossary.ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρτύνετο: ἀρτύνω — arrange, prepare, set in order; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’arranged, framed’
glossary.ἀτρέος: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon and Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεκέως: ἀτρεκής — exact, unswerving; adv. ἀτρεκέως: ’exactly, precisely’
glossary.ἄγετ: ἄγω — lead; pl. imper. ’come now!’, elided (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετε), addressed to a group · also ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided and unaugmented (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετο): ’brought for himself’ (of taking a bride)
glossary.ἄγχιστα: ἄγχι — near; superl. adv. ἄγχιστα: ’nearest, most closely’
glossary.ἄκουσε: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσε)
glossary.ἄλγεά: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄλγη); accent from enclitic τε
glossary.ἄλλοθεν: ἄλλοθεν — from elsewhere, from another place; adv. (ἄλλος + -θεν ’from’)
glossary.ἄνευθεν: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart, aside, at a distance; adv.
glossary.ἄφθιτον: ἄφθιτος — imperishable, undying; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἅπαντας: ἅπας — all, the whole, every; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐδήσατο: δέω — bind; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’bound on (for oneself)’
glossary.ἐεισάμενος: εἴδομαι — seem; make oneself like (+ dat.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐεισάμενος: ’having likened himself (to)’
glossary.ἐκήρυσσον: κηρύσσω — proclaim, make proclamation; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐλεαίρει: ἐλεαίρω — pity, feel compassion for (epic by-form of ἐλεέω); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐνύπνιον: ἐνύπνιος — in sleep; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’in sleep, in a dream’
glossary.ἐπέγναμψεν: ἐπιγνάμπτω — bend, bend to one’s will (γνάμπτω = κάμπτω); aor. 3 sg.: ’bent, swayed’
glossary.ἐπιτέλλω: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, give charge to; pres. 1 sg.: ’I give charge’
glossary.ἐπιτετράφαται: ἐπιτρέπω — entrust, turn over to; perf. pass. 3 pl., epic -αται (= Attic -ανται): ’are entrusted’
glossary.ἐρητύειν: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; pres. inf., used as an imperative: ’hold (them) back!’
glossary.ἐφῆπται: ἐφάπτω — fasten upon; perf. pass. 3 sg., + dat.: ’is fastened upon’
glossary.ἐῴκει: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; plpf. with impf. force, 3 sg.: ’resembled’
glossary.ἔγρετο: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse; aor. 3 sg. mid., 2nd aorist, epic (sense of Attic ἠγέρθη): ’awoke’
glossary.ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
glossary.ἔμελλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (root μελλ-, consonant-initial; unaugmented μέλλε(ν)): ’was going to, was destined’
glossary.ἔμελλον: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 pl. · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I was destined, was about to’ + fut. inf.
glossary.ἔνδυνε: ἐνδύω (ἐνδύνω) — put on (clothing); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented ἔνδυνε (= ἐνέδυνε): ’put on’
glossary.ἔνισπε: ἐνέπω — tell, relate; aor. 3 sg. (2nd aor. ἔνισπον): ’told’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. ἔνισπε: ’tell!’
glossary.ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
glossary.ἕλοι: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would take’
glossary.ἕλοις: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. opt. 2 sg., potential with κε: ’you could take’
glossary.ἠγείροντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’gathered themselves’
glossary.ἠμαθόεντος: ἠμαθόεις — sandy (epithet of Pylos); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn, the goddess; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἡγήτορες: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’leaders!’
glossary.ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
glossary.ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
glossary.ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἱπποκορυσταὶ: ἱπποκορυστής — armed with horses, i.e. chariot-fighters (sense uncertain; ἵππος + κορύσσω ’arm’); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
glossary.ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
glossary.ἷζε: ἵζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 sg.: ’sat down’
glossary.ὀλέσῃ: ὄλλυμι — destroy; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in an indirect deliberation after ὡς: ’he should destroy’
glossary.ὀμφή: ὀμφή — voice of a god, divine utterance; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀρθωθείς: ὀρθόω — set upright, raise; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised himself, sitting up’
glossary.ὑσμίνας: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ᾤχετ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾤχετ’ = ᾤχετο): ’went’
glossary.αἰσχρὸν: αἰσχρός — shameful, disgraceful; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’a shame’
glossary.αἱρήσομεν: αἱρέω — take, capture; fut. 1 pl.: ’we shall take’
glossary.αἴης: αἶα — land, earth; fem. gen. sg., epic by-form of γαῖα (= Attic γῆς)
glossary.βαθείης: βαθύς — deep; fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
glossary.βαθὺ: βαθύς — deep, thick; neut. acc. sg., of standing grain: ’deep-standing’
glossary.βαρείῃ: βαρύς — heavy, grievous; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ)
glossary.βασιλῆες: βασιλεύς — king; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.βεβάασι: βαίνω — go, step; perf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic βεβᾶσι): of years, ’have gone by’
glossary.βοτρυδὸν: βοτρυδόν — in clusters, like a bunch of grapes; adv.
glossary.βουλεύσατο: βουλεύω — plan, devise; mid. devise for oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐβουλεύσατο)
glossary.βουλῆς: βουλή — counsel, plan; council; fem. gen. sg. · with ἐξάρχω, ’out of the council’ · with ἐπακούω, ’(heed) the counsel’
glossary.βοόωντες: βοάω — shout, cry aloud; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic βοῶντες)
glossary.γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
glossary.γλαφυρῆς: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.δεδήει: δαίω — burn, blaze; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. δέδηα, intrans.): ’was ablaze’
glossary.δεκάδας: δεκάς — group of ten, ten; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.δεκάδες: δεκάς — group of ten, ten; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.δευοίατο: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= Attic -οιντο): ’would lack’
glossary.δεῦρ: δεῦρο — hither, here; adv., elided (δεῦρ’ = δεῦρο)
glossary.διακοσμηθεῖμεν: διακοσμέω — arrange in order, marshal; aor. opt. pass. 1 pl.: ’were marshalled’
glossary.διακτόρῳ: διάκτορος — guide, messenger, epithet of Hermes (sense uncertain); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δοῦρα: δόρυ — beam, timber; also spear; neut. nom./acc. pl. δοῦρα, of a ship’s timbers
glossary.δυσκλέα: δυσκλεής — inglorious; masc. acc. sg., contracted (= Attic δυσκλεᾶ), agreeing with an unexpressed ’me’
glossary.δῶκ: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (δῶκ’ = ἔδωκε)
glossary.δῶκεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκεν)
glossary.εἰαρινοῖσιν: εἰαρινός — of spring; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic ἐαρινοῖς)
glossary.εἰῶσ: ἐάω — allow, let; pres. 3 pl., elided (εἰῶσ’ = εἰῶσι), epic εἰ- (= Attic ἐῶσι): ’they allow’
glossary.εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.: ’I may say’
glossary.εἵατ: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 3 pl., epic εἵαται (= Attic κάθηνται), elided (εἵατ’ = εἵαται): ’sit’
glossary.εἶσι: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg. (neut. pl. subject with a sing. verb): ’go forth’
glossary.εὐρέα: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -έα, agreeing with νῶτα: ’broad (backs)’
glossary.εὐχωλὴν: εὐχωλή — vaunt, boast; a thing to boast of, triumph; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὖρός: Εὖρος — the East Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg., accented εὖρός before the enclitic τε
glossary.ζέφυρος: Ζέφυρος — Zephyr, the west wind; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεράποντες: θεράπων — attendant, comrade-in-arms; masc. voc. pl., in address: ’servants (of Ares)’
glossary.θνῄσκων: θνῄσκω — die; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’dying’
glossary.θυέστ: Θυέστης — Thyestes, brother of Atreus; masc. nom. sg., epic Θυέστα, elided (Θυέστ’ = Θυέστα)
glossary.θυέστῃ: Θυέστης — Thyestes, brother of Atreus; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κάμε: κάμνω — toil, labour, grow weary; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαμε): ’toiled’ (κάμε τεύχων ’toiled at making’)
glossary.κάρηνα: κάρηνον — head, summit; pl. mountain peaks; of a city, its towers or battlements; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κέλευον: κελεύω — bid, urge on; impf. 3 pl.: ’were urging’
glossary.καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, down to; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing (καθ’ ἕδρας ’down to their seats’)
glossary.κακὴν: κακός — bad, evil; fem. acc. sg. (κακὴν ἀπάτην ’an evil deceit’)
glossary.κατέλυσε: καταλύω — loosen, break down, destroy; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.κατένευσεν: κατανεύω — nod assent, promise by a nod; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable
glossary.κελεύει: κελεύω — bid, urge, order; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κινήθη: κινέω — set in motion, stir; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was stirred’
glossary.κινήσῃ: κινέω — set in motion, stir; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., after ὡς δ’ ὅτε: ’when … stirs’
glossary.κλαγγῆς: κλαγγή — clamour, din; fem. gen. sg., with παυσάμενοι: ’(ceasing) from the din’
glossary.κλισιάων: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic κλισιῶν)
glossary.κονίη: κονία — dust; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -α)
glossary.κρονίδης: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus (Zeus); masc. nom. sg., patronymic
glossary.κὰδ: κατά (κάδ before δ-) — down; preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (κὰδ … λίποιεν = καταλίποιεν ’leave behind’)
glossary.λάβρος: λάβρος — furious, boisterous; masc. nom. sg., of a wind
glossary.λέλυνται: λύω — loose, undo; perf. 3 pl. pass.: ’have been loosened’
glossary.λέξασθαι: λέγω — pick out, count up; aor. inf. mid.: ’to pick out for oneself’
glossary.λήϊον: λήϊον — standing crop, grain-field; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λίποιεν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. opt. 3 pl., potential with κεν: ’would leave’
glossary.λίποιτε: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. opt. 2 pl., potential with κεν: ’you would leave’
glossary.λαερτιάδη: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; voc. sg.
glossary.λαόν: λαός — people, host, army; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λαός: λαός — people, host, army; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λεῖπε: λείπω — leave, leave behind; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλειπε)
glossary.λύσει: λύω — loose, break up; fut. 3 sg.: ’will bring down’
glossary.μεγάροις: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. pl.: ’in the halls’
glossary.μελαίνης: μέλας, μέλαινα — black, dark; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μελισσάων: μέλισσα — bee; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ), with an imperative: ’and do not’ · also with an optative of wish: ’and let … not’ (μηδ’ ἔτι … εἴην ’and may I no longer be’) · also with a hortatory subj.: ’and let us not’ (μηδ’ … ἀμβαλλώμεθα ’and let us not put off’)
glossary.μὰψ: μάψ — idly, to no purpose, recklessly; adv.
glossary.μῆτιν: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, counsel; fem. acc. sg., of respect: ’in counsel’
glossary.νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
glossary.νήεσσι: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νήεσσι (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νήπια: νήπιος — childish, infant; neut. nom. pl., attributive: νήπια τέκνα ’infant children’
glossary.νήσοισι: νῆσος — island; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.νεφελάων: νεφέλη — cloud; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
glossary.νόστος: νόστος — homecoming, return; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νότος: Νότος — the South Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νῶτα: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. pl., poetic ’the broad back of the sea’ · also acc. pl. of respect, ’on the back’ (ἐπὶ νῶτα δαφοινός ’blood-red on the back’)
glossary.οἰνοχοεύειν: οἰνοχοεύω — pour wine, act as cupbearer; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic οἰνοχοεῖν)
glossary.οἰνοχόοιο: οἰνοχόος — wine-pourer, cupbearer; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with δευοίατο
glossary.οἴκαδε: οἴκαδε — homeward, to one’s home; adv., οἶκος + directional suffix -δε
glossary.οὐρούς: οὖρος — trench, ditch in which a ship is drawn up (traditional sense); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πέλοπι: Πέλοψ — Pelops, son of Tantalus; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πέλοψ: Πέλοψ — Pelops, son of Tantalus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πέτρης: πέτρη — rock, cliff; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πέφανται: φαίνω — show; mid./pass. appear; perf. 3 sg. pass.: ’has appeared, is plain’
glossary.παντὶ: πᾶς — all, whole; neut. dat. sg., agreeing with Ἄργεϊ: ’all Argos’
glossary.πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην … πατρίδα γαῖαν ’dear native land’)
glossary.πατρίδος: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.παυροτέροισι: παῦρος — few, small; compar. παυρότερος ’fewer’; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.παυσάμενοι: παύω — stop; mid. cease from (+ gen.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having ceased’
glossary.πειθώμεθα: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, + dat.; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us obey’
glossary.πεποτήαται: ποτάομαι — fly about, flit; perf. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic πεποτῶνται): ’flit about’
glossary.πεσόντες: πίπτω — fall, throw oneself; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having thrown yourselves (into)’
glossary.πιστὰ: πιστός — trusty, faithful; neut. acc. pl., attributive: ὅρκια πιστά ’faithful oaths’
glossary.πλάζουσι: πλάζω — drive astray, baffle, hinder; pres. 3 pl. act.
glossary.πλέας: πλείων — more; masc. acc. pl., epic πλέας (= Attic πλείονας), with υἷας
glossary.πληθὺν: πληθύς — throng, crowd, multitude; fem. acc. sg.: μετὰ πληθύν ’through the throng’
glossary.πληξίππῳ: πληξίππος — horse-lashing, driver of horses; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Pelops
glossary.ποιμένι: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in the standing royal title ποιμὴν λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’
glossary.πολεμίζειν: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf.: πόλεμον πολεμίζειν ’to wage war’
glossary.πολλάων: πολύς — much, many; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic πολλῶν)
glossary.πολλέων: πολύς — much, many; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic πολλῶν)
glossary.πολλαί: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.πολλῇσιν: πολύς — much, many; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic πολλαῖς)
glossary.πολυμήχαν: πολυμήχανος — of many devices, resourceful; masc. voc. sg., elided (πολυμήχαν’ = πολυμήχανε)
glossary.πολύαρνι: πολύαρνος — rich in lambs, rich in sheep; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Thyestes
glossary.πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’a great host’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with χρόνον: ’a long (time)’
glossary.ποτιδέγμεναι: ποτιδέχομαι — await, wait for; pres. inf. mid., epic ποτι- and -μεναι (= Attic προσδέχεσθαι)
glossary.πριάμῳ: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
glossary.πτόλιν: πτόλις (epic by-form of πόλις) — city; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πυθέσθαι: πυνθάνομαι — inquire, learn, hear of; aor. inf. mid., epexegetic: αἰσχρὸν … πυθέσθαι ’a shame to hear of’
glossary.πόντου: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πᾶσ: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., elided (πᾶσ’ = πᾶσα), agreeing with ἀγορή
glossary.σέσηπε: σήπω — make rot; perf. 3 sg., intrans.: ’has rotted’ (neut. pl. subject with a sing. verb)
glossary.σκηπτοῦχοι: σκηπτοῦχος — sceptre-bearing, sceptred; masc. nom. pl., adj. with βασιλῆες
glossary.σπάρτα: σπάρτον — rope, cable; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.σπουδῇ: σπουδή — haste, effort; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’in haste, with effort’
glossary.στεναχίζετο: στεναχίζω — groan, sigh, resound with groaning; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass.
glossary.σφεας: σφεῖς — they; epic acc. pl. pron. (= Attic σφᾶς): ’them’
glossary.σφισιν: σφεῖς — they; epic dat. pl. pron. (= Attic σφίσιν): ’among them, to them’
glossary.σχέτλιος: σχέτλιος — cruel, ruthless, hard-hearted; masc. nom. sg., of a person or god
glossary.σχοίατ: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. hold oneself back from (+ gen.); aor. opt. mid. 3 pl., elided, epic σχοίατο (= Attic σχοῖντο)
glossary.τέλος: τέλος — end, fulfilment, outcome; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ταμόντες: τάμνω (τέμνω) — cut; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., epic τάμνω (= Attic τεμόντες): ὅρκια ταμόντες ’cutting a sworn pact’
glossary.τετρήχει: ταράσσω — stir, trouble; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. τέτρηχα, intrans.): ’was in an uproar’
glossary.τεύχων: τεύχω — make, fashion; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’making’
glossary.τοιόνδε: τοιόσδε — such as this, of this kind; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν
glossary.τοσόνδε: τοσόσδε — so great, so large; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν
glossary.τροίῃ: Τροίη — Troy; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Τροίᾳ)
glossary.τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.τρῶές: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.φίλης: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φεύγωμεν: φεύγω — flee; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us flee’
glossary.φεύξεσθ: φεύγω — flee; fut. 2 pl. mid., elided (φεύξεσθ’ = φεύξεσθε): ’you will flee’
glossary.φεύξονται: φεύγω — flee; fut. 3 pl. mid.: ’they will flee’
glossary.φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.φορῆναι: φορέω — carry, bear; pres. inf., epic -ῆναι (= Attic φορεῖν)
glossary.φὴ: φή — like, as; epic adv. of comparison (= ὡς), introducing a simile
glossary.φῶτα: φώς — man, mortal; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀΐξασα: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγέροντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, epic (= ἠγέροντο): ’gathered’
glossary.ἀγανοῖς: ἀγανός — gentle, soothing; masc./neut. dat. pl., attributive: ἀγανοῖς ἐπέεσσιν ’with gentle words’
glossary.ἀγορή: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering-place; fem. nom. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀγορήν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering-place; fem. acc. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀγορὴ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. nom. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
glossary.ἀειρομένη: ἀείρω — lift, raise; mid. rise up; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic αἰρομένη): ’rising’
glossary.ἀκούσειαν: ἀκούω — hear, listen to (+ gen.); aor. opt. 3 pl.: ’might listen to’
glossary.ἀκράαντον: ἀκράαντος — unaccomplished, fruitless; neut. acc. sg., predicate: ’in vain’
glossary.ἀλαλητῷ: ἀλαλητός — war-cry, shout; masc. dat. sg., of manner: ’with a shout’
glossary.ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἀμφιελίσσας: ἀμφιέλισσα — curved at both ends (standing epithet of ships); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀπάτην: ἀπάτη — deceit, trick; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπονέεσθαι: ἀπονέομαι — go back, return; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπονεῖσθαι)
glossary.ἀπόλοντο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. ἀπόλλυμαι, perish, die; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic ἀπόλοντο (= Attic ἀπώλοντο)
glossary.ἀργείην: Ἀργεῖος — Argive, of Argos; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -είην (= Attic Ἀργείαν)
glossary.ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀργεϊφόντῃ: ἀργεϊφόντης — Argeïphontes, epithet of Hermes, of unknown or disputed meaning; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀριθμηθήμεναι: ἀριθμέω — count, number; aor. inf. pass., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic ἀριθμηθῆναι): ’to be counted’
glossary.ἀσταχύεσσιν: ἀστάχυς (= στάχυς) — ear of grain; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -σι)
glossary.ἀτάλαντον: ἀτάλαντος — equal in weight, matching (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτρέϊ: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἀτρεῖ)
glossary.ἀτρεὺς: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀτρυτώνη: Ἀτρυτώνη — Atrytone, cult-title of Athena, traditionally ’the Unwearied’, though the derivation is uncertain; fem. voc. sg.
glossary.ἀϋτὴ: ἀϋτή — shout, battle-cry; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀϋτῆς: ἀϋτή — shout, battle-cry; fem. gen. sg., with σχοίατο: ’(refrain) from shouting’
glossary.ἁδινάων: ἁδινός — thronging, close-packed, clamorous (sense debated); fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἄγεθ: ἄγω — lead, bring; imper. 2 pl., elided (ἄγεθ’ = ἄγετε), as an interjection: ’come now!’
glossary.ἄνθεσιν: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’)
glossary.ἄπρηκτον: ἄπρηκτος — fruitless, without result; two-ending adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόλεμον
glossary.ἄργος: Ἄργος — Argos, the Argive land (Greece); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also the Pelasgian Argos, a district of northern Greece; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως)
glossary.ἄτῃ: ἄτη — blind folly, delusion, ruin; fem. dat. sg., of means
glossary.ἅλις: ἅλις — in crowds, in abundance, enough; adv.
glossary.ἅπτεσθαι: ἅπτομαι — take hold of, lay hold of (+ gen.); pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἅπτετ: ἅπτομαι — take hold of, touch (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἅπτετ’ = ἅπτετο)
glossary.ἐγχέσπαλοι: ἐγχέσπαλος — spear-brandishing, spear-wielding; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐθέλοιμεν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 1 pl., in a condition after εἴ περ: ’if we were willing’
glossary.ἐθέλοντα: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’(me) though I wish’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a relative: ’wishing (to hang back)’
glossary.ἐκπέρσαντ: ἐκπέρθω — sack utterly, destroy; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐκπέρσαντ’ = ἐκπέρσαντα): ’having sacked’
glossary.ἐνέδησε: ἐνδέω — bind in, entangle; aor. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἐξεκάθαιρον: ἐκκαθαίρω — clear out, clean out; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐξῆρχε: ἐξάρχω — lead off, lead the way, begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπάκουσαν: ἐπακούω — listen to, give heed to (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl.: ’heeded’
glossary.ἐπίκουροι: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπαΐξας: ἐπαΐσσω — dart upon, rush at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπαιγίζων: ἐπαιγίζω — swoop down on like a squall, of wind (sense traditional); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπανέστησαν: ἐπανίστημι — rise up; aor. 3 pl. act., intrans.: ’rose up’
glossary.ἐπεσσεύοντο: ἐπισεύομαι — hurry on, rush to; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐπεσεύοντο): ’hastened on’
glossary.ἐρήτυε: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold back!’
glossary.ἐρήτυθεν: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic -θεν (= Attic ἠρητύθησαν): ’were held back’
glossary.ἐρήτυον: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; impf. 3 pl.: ’were holding back’
glossary.ἐρεισάμενος: ἐρείδω — prop, lean; mid. lean on; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’leaning (on)’
glossary.ἐρχομενάων: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic ἐρχομένων): ’coming’
glossary.ἐρώει: ἐρωέω — hold back, hang back; pres. imper. 2 sg., after μηδ’: ’do not hang back’
glossary.ἐσσεύοντο: σεύω — set moving; mid. rush, hasten; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic augment with doubled σ (ἐσσ-): ’rushed’
glossary.ἐσσομένοισι: εἰμί — be; fut. part. masc. dat. pl., epic ἐσσομένοισι (= Attic ἐσομένοις): ’to those yet to be’
glossary.ἐστιχόωντο: στιχάομαι — march in rows, go in ranks; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐστιχῶντο)
glossary.ἐτύχθη: τεύχω — make, bring about; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’came to pass’
glossary.ἐφέστιοι: ἐφέστιος — at the hearth, resident; masc. nom. pl.: ’householders’
glossary.ἐϋσσέλμοιο: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched (of ships; σέλματα are the rowing-benches); fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἑλένην: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑλκέμεν: ἕλκω — drag, haul; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἕλκειν)
glossary.ἑλοίμεθα: αἱρέω — take; mid. choose; aor. opt. mid. 1 pl. (stem ἑλ-), potential: ’we would choose’
glossary.ἑρμείας: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑσταότ: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἑσταότ’ = ἑσταότα, Attic ἑστηκότα): ’standing’
glossary.ἔασιν: εἰμί — be; epic pres. 3 pl. (= Attic εἰσίν): ’are’
glossary.ἔθνεα: ἔθνος — tribe, throng, swarm; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔθνη)
glossary.ἔλιπεν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔπ: ἐπί — to, towards; prep. + acc., following its noun with accent thrown back (ἔπι) and elided (ἔπ’)
glossary.ἔπε: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl. (ἔπεα), elided (ἔπε’), epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
glossary.ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
glossary.ἕκαστοι: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. pl.: ’each of us’
glossary.ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.: ’each (man)’
glossary.ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
glossary.ἠμύει: ἠμύω — bow, droop, sink down; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἠϊόνος: ἠϊών — shore, beach; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἡμέτεραί: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; fem. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl.: ’we’
glossary.ἥρωες: ἥρως — hero; masc. voc. pl. (same as nom.), in address: ’heroes!’ · also nom. pl., subject: ’the heroes’ (ἥρωες Δαναοί … διδοῦσιν)
glossary.ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; fem. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (ἧς εἵνεκα ’for whose sake’) · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with its noun (ἧς ἀλόχοιο ’his own wife’)
glossary.ἰκαρίοιο: Ἰκάριος — Icarian, of the Icarian Sea; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἰλαδὸν: ἰλαδόν — in troops, in companies; adv.
glossary.ἱεμένων: ἵεμαι — hasten, press on, be eager; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’hastening’
glossary.ἱζόντων: ἵζω — sit down, take a seat; pres. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’as they sat down’
glossary.ἱκόμεσθα: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’we came’
glossary.ἱσταμένη: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. stand, come to stand; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’coming to stand, standing’
glossary.ἵστατ: ἵστημι — set; mid. stand, rise; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἵστατ’ = ἵστατο): ’rose, stood up’
glossary.ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
glossary.ὀτρύνουσ: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (ὀτρύνουσ’ = ὀτρύνουσα): ’urging’
glossary.ὄρινε: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; impf./aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤρινε): ’stirred’
glossary.ὄσσα: ὄσσα — voice, rumour, report; Ossa, Rumour personified as a messenger of Zeus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὅμαδος: ὅμαδος — din, uproar of a crowd; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὅρκια: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. acc. pl.: ὅρκια τάμνειν ’to swear a pact’ (lit. cut victims)
glossary.ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’
glossary.ὑπένερθε: ὑπένερθε(ν) — below, underneath, beneath; adv., also + gen.: ποδῶν ὑπένερθε ’beneath their feet’
glossary.ὑπέρμορα: ὑπέρμορα — beyond fate, contrary to destiny; adv. (neut. pl. of ὑπέρμορος)
glossary.ὑπέσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ὑπο- + ἐ- elides to ὑπε-): ’promised’
glossary.ὑπερμενέϊ: ὑπερμενής — overmastering, very mighty; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
glossary.ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
glossary.ὤλεσα: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 1 sg.: ’I lost’
glossary.ὤρορ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; aor. 3 sg. (reduplicated ὤρορε), elided (ὤρορ’ = ὤρορε)
glossary.ᾕρεον: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾕρουν); with ὑπό in tmesis, ’they took away from under’
glossary.αἰγιαλῷ: αἰγιαλός — beach, shore; masc. dat. sg., of place: ’on the beach’
glossary.αἰδῶ: αἰδώς — shame, sense of shame; fem. acc. sg.; of what is covered, ’the shame’, i.e. the private parts
glossary.αἱματόεσσα: αἱματόεις — bloody, blood-red; fem. nom. sg., epic -όεσσα (= Attic -όεισα)
glossary.αἴσχιστος: αἰσχρός — shameful, ugly; superl. αἴσχιστος, masc. nom. sg.: ’ugliest’
glossary.αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg., as a plain pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ) · also intensive: ’himself’
glossary.βασιλεύσομεν: βασιλεύω — be king, rule; fut. 1 pl.: ’we shall be kings’
glossary.βασιλεῦσιν: βασιλεύς — king; masc. dat. pl.: ἐριζέμεναι βασιλεῦσιν ’to strive with kings’
glossary.βασιλῆας: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.βουλεύῃσι: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι (= Attic -ῃ), in a purpose clause: ’that he may take counsel’
glossary.βουλῇ: βουλή — counsel, plan, council; fem. dat. sg. (ἐν βουλῇ ’in council’)
glossary.βοόωντά: βοάω — shout, cry aloud; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic βοῶντα)
glossary.βοῶν: βοάω — shout, cry aloud; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., contracted (= epic βοόων): ’shouting’
glossary.βρέμεται: βρέμω — roar, resound; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’roars’, of the sea
glossary.βροτὸν: βροτός — mortal; masc. acc. sg., as a noun: ’mortal man’ (βροτὸν ἄλλον ’another mortal’)
glossary.γέλασσαν: γελάω — laugh; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -σσ- and unaugmented (= ἐγέλασαν)
glossary.γέρα: γέρας — prize of honour, due portion; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.γελοίϊον: γέλοιος — laughable, ridiculous; neut. sg., epic -οῖος with diaeresis, predicate of an infinitive: ’laughable’
glossary.γυναῖκα: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γυναῖκες: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. nom. pl.: ’women’
glossary.δέξατό: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδέξατο): ’received’ (+ dat. of the giver)
glossary.δήμου: δῆμος — people, common folk (also the land of a people); masc. gen. sg.: δήμου ἄνδρα ’a man of the people’
glossary.δήσας: δέω — bind, tie; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having bound’
glossary.δίεπε: διέπω — manage, set in order; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= διεῖπε): ’marshalled’
glossary.δαιμόνι: δαιμόνιος — strange, puzzling, odd; voc. sg., elided (δαιμόνι’ = δαιμόνιε), as address: ’strange one’ (gentle or chiding, tone uncertain)
glossary.δαναοί: Δαναοί — the Danaans, i.e. the Greeks (= Achaeans, Argives); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δειδίσσεσθαι: δειδίσσομαι — be frightened, fear (epic; same stem as Attic δεδίττομαι ’frighten’); pres. inf. mid.: ’to be frightened’
glossary.διδοῦσιν: δίδωμι — give; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic διδόασι)
glossary.δύσω: δύω — strip off, put off (trans.); fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall strip’, with ἀπό in tmesis
glossary.εἰσὶν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable: ’they are’
glossary.εἴην: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 1 sg.: ’I would be’ · also in a wish or self-curse: ’may I (not) be’
glossary.εἴπεσκεν: εἶπον — say, speak; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (Attic εἶπε): ’would say, used to say’
glossary.εἴσαιτο: εἴδομαι — seem, appear (+ dat.); aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in an indefinite relative clause: ’whatever might seem’
glossary.εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’clothes’
glossary.εὐρυβάτης: Εὐρυβάτης — Eurybates, Odysseus’ herald (’wide-strider’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θέειν: θέω — run; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῖν)
glossary.θήν: θήν — surely, indeed; epic enclitic particle (= Attic δήπου)
glossary.θαλερὸν: θαλερός — blooming, vigorous, swelling; adj., neut. nom. sg.: θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’an abundant tear’
glossary.θερσίτης: Θερσίτης — Thersites, a common soldier of the Greek army; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θερσῖτ: Θερσίτης — Thersites; masc. voc. sg., elided (Θερσῖτ’ = Θερσῖτα): ’Thersites!’
glossary.κατίσχεαι: κατίσχω (= κατέχω) — hold, keep back for oneself; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic -ῃ), in a relative clause: ’whom you keep back’
glossary.κεκλήγων: κλάζω — shriek, cry loudly; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -ων (= κεκληγώς), present sense: ’shrieking’
glossary.κεκλημένος: καλέω — call, name; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’called’
glossary.κερτομέων: κερτομέω — taunt, mock, jeer at; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κερτομῶν)
glossary.κεφαλήν: κεφαλή — head; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’in the head’
glossary.κιχήσομαι: κιχάνω — come upon, find, reach; fut. 1 sg. mid., epic: ’I shall find’
glossary.κιχείη: κιχάνω — come upon, find, reach; aor. opt. 3 sg., athematic (ἔκιχον, κιχείην), in a general relative clause: ’whom he might come upon’
glossary.κλαίοντα: κλαίω — weep; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’weeping’
glossary.κλισίαι: κλισίη — hut, tent; fem. nom. pl., Ionic -ίη (= Attic κλισία)
glossary.κλισίῃς: κλισίη — hut, tent; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic κλισίαις)
glossary.κοίρανος: κοίρανος — ruler, commander, lord; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κοιρανέων: κοιρανέω — rule, be lord, command; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κοιρανῶν)
glossary.κορύσσων: κορύσσω — arm, equip; of war, array, stir up; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κοτέοντο: κοτέομαι — be angry, bear a grudge (+ dat.); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic uncontracted
glossary.κρόνου: Κρόνος — Cronus, father of Zeus; masc. gen. sg.: Κρόνου πάϊς ’son of Cronus’ is Zeus
glossary.κυρτὼ: κυρτός — bent, humped; masc. dual nom., agreeing with ὤμω: ’humped’
glossary.κόμισσε: κομίζω — take care of, tend, look after; aor. 3 sg., epic σσ (= ἐκόμισε), unaugmented
glossary.κόσμον: κόσμος — order, due order, propriety; masc. acc. sg. (οὐ κατὰ κόσμον ’not in due order’)
glossary.λάχνη: λάχνη — wool, downy hair; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λέγ: λέγω — say, tell; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (λέγ’ = ἔλεγε): ’kept saying’
glossary.λαβὼν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’, ’having seized’
glossary.λαούς: λαός — people, men; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.λιγύς: λιγύς — clear-voiced, shrill; masc. nom. sg.: ’clear-voiced’
glossary.λωβητῆρα: λωβητήρ — reviler, one who outrages; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μάλιστ: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα, elided (μάλιστ’ = μάλιστα): ’most of all, especially’
glossary.μάψ: μάψ — rashly, idly, without due cause; adv.
glossary.μίσγεαι: μίσγω — mix; mid. have intercourse with; pres. mid. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic -ῃ), subj. after ἵνα: ’that you may lie with’
glossary.μεθήμων: μεθήμων — slack, remiss, easy-going; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μετάφρενον: μετάφρενον — the back (between the shoulders); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.μεταφρένου: μετάφρενον — the back (between the shoulders); neut. gen. sg.
glossary.μηκέτ: μηκέτι — no longer, no more; adv., elided (μηκέτ’ = μηκέτι)
glossary.μοῦνος: μόνος (epic/Ionic μοῦνος) — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νέην: νέος — young, new; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.νείκεε: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐνείκει): ’he reviled’
glossary.νεικείειν: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεικεῖν)
glossary.νεικείεσκε: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic: ’used to revile’
glossary.νεικείων: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεικῶν)
glossary.νεμέσσηθέν: νεμεσσάω — feel righteous anger, resent; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic -θεν (= Attic ἐνεμεσήθησαν), unaugmented
glossary.νεώμεθα: νέομαι — go, go back, return; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
glossary.νοστήσομεν: νοστέω — return home; fut. 1 pl. (or short-vowel aor. subj.): ’we shall return’
glossary.νόος: νόος — mind, purpose; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic νοῦς)
glossary.νόστόν: νόστος — homecoming, return; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.οἴκαδέ: οἴκαδε — homeward, to one’s home; adv. (οἶκος + -δε)
glossary.οἴσει: φέρω — bear, carry, bring; fut. 3 sg. (fut. οἴσω): ’will bring’
glossary.οἶσθ: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense, elided (οἶσθ’ = οἶσθα): ’you know’
glossary.οἷος: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. nom. sg., rough breathing (not οἶος ’alone’); in an indirect question: ’what sort of’
glossary.οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
glossary.οὐκί: οὐ — not; emphatic form οὐκί: ’not’ (ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’)
glossary.πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
glossary.πέπονες: πέπων — ripe, soft; in address a familiar ’good (friend)’, exact sense uncertain; masc. voc. pl. (said to a crowd, scornfully)
glossary.παρίστατο: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, come up to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.: ’stood by’
glossary.παραστάς: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’standing beside’
glossary.πειρᾶται: πειράομαι — try, test, make trial of; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’he is testing’
glossary.πεπλήγων: πλήσσω — strike; reduplicated aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (form disputed): ’striking, driving off with blows’
glossary.πεσσέμεν: πέσσω — cook, digest; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic πέσσειν): of prizes, ’to digest, devour at leisure’
glossary.πλεῖαί: πλεῖος — full; fem. nom. pl. (Ionic, = Attic πλέως), + gen.: ’full of’
glossary.πληγῇσιν: πληγή — blow, stroke; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.πλησίον: πλησίος — near, neighbouring; neut. acc. sg. as adv. πλησίον: ’near, beside’; ἐς πλησίον ἄλλον ’to another next to him’
glossary.πολέμῳ: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πολλαὶ: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.: ’many’
glossary.πολυκοιρανίη: πολυκοιρανίη — rule by many lords; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -ίη (= Attic -ία)
glossary.προσαμύνομεν: προσαμύνω — come to help, aid (+ dat.); pres. 1 pl.: ’we help’
glossary.προφέροις: προφέρω — bring forward, cast at (+ dat.); pres. opt. 2 sg., potential: ’you would cast (reproaches) at’
glossary.πρωτίστῳ: πρῶτος — first; superl. πρώτιστος, masc. dat. sg.: ’(to you) first’
glossary.πόδα: πούς — foot; masc. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’in the foot’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’foot’ of a mountain, after ὑπαί (πόδα νείατον Ἴδης)
glossary.πόλεμόν: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πόντος: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison: ’than you’
glossary.σκήπτρου: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.σκῆπτρόν: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre; neut. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τ’)
glossary.σμαραγεῖ: σμαραγέω — roar, resound, crash; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.σμῶδιξ: σμῶδιξ — weal, welt (the mark of a blow); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.στόμ: στόμα — mouth; neut. acc. sg., elided (στόμ’ = στόμα)
glossary.στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.συνοχωκότε: συνέχω — hold together, draw together; perf. part. act. dual nom., epic συνοχωκότε: ’drawn together’
glossary.σφισι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς): ’to/for them’
glossary.τάρβησέν: ταρβέω — be afraid, be alarmed; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’was afraid’
glossary.τέο: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., Homeric/Ionic gen. sg. (= Attic τίνος): ’of what?’
glossary.τηλεμάχοιο: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο: Τηλεμάχοιο πατήρ ’father of Telemachus’
glossary.τιμὴ: τιμή — honour, standing, esteem; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τόνδε: ὅδε — this, this one; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
glossary.υἷος: υἱός — son; masc. gen. sg., epic υἷος (= Attic υἱοῦ), objective gen. with ἄποινα: ’ransom for a son’
glossary.φάθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (φάθ’ = φάτο before rough breathing): ’so she spoke’
glossary.φέρτεροί: φέρτερος — stronger, better, superior; comparative adj. (no positive in use), masc. nom. pl., + gen. of comparison: ’stronger than’
glossary.φημὶ: φημί — say, assert, declare; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.φιλεῖ: φιλέω — love, hold dear; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’loves’
glossary.φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; also sexual love; fem. dat. sg.: ἐν φιλότητι ’in love’
glossary.φολκὸς: φολκός — bandy-legged (meaning uncertain); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φοξὸς: φοξός — pointed, peaked (of the head); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φυλάσσοις: φυλάσσω — guard, keep watch for; pres. opt. 2 sg., potential: ’you would watch for’
glossary.φωνησάσης: φωνέω — raise the voice, speak aloud; aor. part. act. fem. gen. sg.: ’who had spoken’
glossary.χαλεπῷ: χαλεπός — harsh, hard, grievous; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.χαλκοῦ: χαλκός — bronze, copper; masc. gen. sg.: πλεῖαι χαλκοῦ ’full of bronze’
glossary.χατίζεις: χατίζω — need, lack, want (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg.
glossary.χερειότερον: χερείων — worse, inferior; comparative χερειότερος, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.χλαῖνάν: χλαῖνα — a thick woollen cloak; fem. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic τ’)
glossary.χλαῖναν: χλαῖνα — cloak, mantle; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χολωσάμενος: χολόω — anger; mid. grow angry; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having grown angry’
glossary.χρυσέου: χρύσεος — golden; masc. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦ)
glossary.χἠμεῖς: ἐγώ — I; χἠμεῖς = καὶ ἡμεῖς by crasis (ἡμεῖς nom. pl. ’we’): ’and we too’
glossary.ψεδνὴ: ψεδνός — thin, sparse; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγάγω: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. subj. 1 sg. act., with κεν in a general relative clause: ’I may bring’
glossary.ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγαθὸν: ἀγαθός — good; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(not) good’
glossary.ἀγκυλομήτεω: ἀγκυλομήτης — of crooked cunning (exact sense uncertain); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου), epithet of Cronus
glossary.ἀγοράων: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering, public speaking; fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ἀγορῶν)
glossary.ἀγορεύοις: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare; pres. opt. 2 sg., potential with ἄν: ’you would speak’
glossary.ἀγορῆθεν: ἀγορή — assembly, place of assembly; adv. ἀγορῆθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the assembly’
glossary.ἀεικέσσι: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful; fem. dat. pl., epic -έσσι (= Attic ἀεικέσι)
glossary.ἀκούσαμεν: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἠκούσαμεν): ’we heard’
glossary.ἀκριτόμυθε: ἀκριτόμυθος — of undiscriminating, confused or endless speech (exact sense uncertain); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἀλγήσας: ἀλγέω — feel pain, suffer; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having felt pain’
glossary.ἀμείνονα: ἀμείνων — better; comparative of ἀγαθός; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμετροεπὴς: ἀμετροεπής — endless in talk, of unmeasured speech; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφικαλύπτει: ἀμφικαλύπτω — cover around, envelop; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνήσει: ἀνίημι — send up, let go; urge on, impel (to do); fut. 3 sg.: ’will urge’
glossary.ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπομόρξατο: ἀπομόργνυμι — wipe off; mid. wipe from oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’wiped away’
glossary.ἀπτόλεμος: ἀπτόλεμος — unwarlike, no fighter; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρχὸν: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτρέμας: ἀτρέμας — without moving, calmly, quietly; adv.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδεω: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀτρεΐδῃς: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. dat. pl., epic Ἀτρεΐδῃς (= Attic Ἀτρείδαις): ’the sons of Atreus’
glossary.ἀτρεΐωνος: Ἀτρεΐων — son of Atreus (= Ἀτρεΐδης); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀφήσω: ἀφίημι — let go, send away; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall send away’
glossary.ἀφραίνοντα: ἀφραίνω — be foolish, act senselessly; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’playing the fool’
glossary.ἀχαιΐδες: Ἀχαιΐς — Achaean woman; fem. nom./voc. pl., of men as an insult: ’Achaean women!’
glossary.ἀχνύμενοί: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
