glossary.ἀχρεῖον: ἀχρεῖος — useless, to no purpose; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’helplessly, blankly’
glossary.ἄκοσμά: ἄκοσμος — disorderly, unseemly; neut. acc. pl. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
glossary.ἄκουε: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’listen!’
glossary.ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄναλκις: ἄναλκις — without courage, feeble; adj. (2-termination), masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’; not the possessive
glossary.ἐκολῴα: κολῳάω — squabble noisily, brawl (like jackdaws); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐλάσασκεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic: ’would strike’
glossary.ἐλέγχε: ἔλεγχος — reproach, disgrace; neut. pl. ἐλέγχεα, elided (ἐλέγχε’), epic uncontracted; nom./voc. pl.: ’disgraces’
glossary.ἐναρίθμιος: ἐναρίθμιος — counted among, of account; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐξάρχων: ἐξάρχω — begin, lead off, take the lead (+ acc. or gen.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐξαίρετοι: ἐξαίρετος — picked out, choice, select; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐξυπανέστη: ἐξυπανίστημι — rise up from under; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist, intrans.): ’rose up’
glossary.ἐπείη: ἔπειμι — be on, be upon (+ dat.); pres. opt. 3 sg., in a wish or curse: ’may it be on’
glossary.ἐπενήνοθε: ἐπενήνοθε — grows on, lies thick on; old perf. 3 sg. with present sense, root uncertain (ἐνήνοθε, ἐπενήνοθε)
glossary.ἐπεσβόλον: ἐπεσβόλος — babbling, loose-tongued (ἔπος + βάλλω); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιβασκέμεν: ἐπιβάσκω — cause to go upon, bring into (+ gen.); pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic -ειν)
glossary.ἐπιδεύεαι: ἐπιδεύομαι — lack, be in need of (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic -ῃ)
glossary.ἐπιμέμφεαι: ἐπιμέμφομαι — blame, find fault with (+ dat. or gen.); pres. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic ἐπιμέμφῃ)
glossary.ἐρητύσασκε: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic: ’would restrain’
glossary.ἐσθλὰ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, staunch; neut. acc. pl.: ’good things, good deeds’
glossary.ἐφεύροι: ἐφευρίσκω — find, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a general relative clause: ’whom he might find’
glossary.ἐῶμεν: ἐάω — allow, let be, leave alone; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us leave’
glossary.ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
glossary.ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἔκπεσε: ἐκπίπτω — fall out, fall from; aor. 3 sg.: of a tear, ’fell from’ (+ dat. of the person)
glossary.ἔξοχον: ἔξοχος — standing out, eminent; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔοικεν: ἔοικα — be like, seem, be fitting; perf. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is fitting’
glossary.ἔοργε: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; perf. 3 sg. act. ἔοργε (from ἔρδω): ’has done’
glossary.ἔρεξεν: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; aor. 3 sg.: ’did’
glossary.ἔσχ: ἔχω — have, hold, hold back; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔσχ’ = ἔσχε): ’held back, kept (from + gen.)’
glossary.ἕζοντο: ἕζομαι — seat oneself, sit down; impf. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.ἕλωμεν: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. subj. 1 pl., in a temporal clause with ἄν: ’whenever we take’
glossary.ἕο: reflexive pron. (= ἑαυτοῦ, Attic οὗ) — himself; gen. sg., gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than himself’
glossary.ἕτερον: ἕτερος — the other (of two), one; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόδα
glossary.ἠνίπαπε: ἐνίπτω — rebuke, chide; aor. 2 3 sg., epic reduplicated (ἠνίπαπον, no Attic equivalent)
glossary.ἠχῇ: ἠχή — sound, outcry, din; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly, heartily’
glossary.ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’whom’; not the possessive
glossary.ἧσαι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 2 sg. mid.: ’you sit’
glossary.ἰδνώθη: ἰδνόω — bend, double up; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was bent double’
glossary.ἰθακήσιος: Ἰθακήσιος — of Ithaca, Ithacan; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱπποδάμων: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; adj., masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that he may see’
glossary.ἴδοι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a past general relative clause: ’whom he might see’
glossary.ἴψεται: ἴπτομαι — press hard, smite, afflict; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’he will smite’
glossary.ἵδρυε: ἱδρύω — make sit, seat, settle; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’seat!’
glossary.ἵνά: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
glossary.ὀνείδεά: ὄνειδος — reproach, taunt, blame; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀνείδη)
glossary.ὀνειδίζων: ὀνειδίζω — reproach, revile, taunt; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’reviling’
glossary.ὀξέα: ὀξύς — sharp, keen, shrill; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’shrilly’
glossary.ὀπήδει: ὀπηδέω — accompany, attend (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, contracted -ει: ’kept company with’
glossary.ὁμοκλήσασκέ: ὁμοκλάω — call out sternly, rebuke; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic: ’would rebuke’
glossary.ὄπα: ὄψ (gen. ὀπός) — voice; fem. acc. sg., epic ὄπα
glossary.ὕπερθε: ὕπερθε(ν) — above, from above, on top; adv.
glossary.ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’
glossary.ὤμω: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual nom./acc.: ’two shoulders’
glossary.ῥέξῃ: ῥέζω — do, perform, accomplish; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή (fear): ’lest he do’
glossary.αἰσχρόν: αἰσχρός — shameful, disgraceful; neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: ’shameful (to stay)’
glossary.αὐλίδα: Αὐλίς — Aulis, the Boeotian harbour where the Greek fleet gathered; fem. acc. sg., place to which: ἐς Αὐλίδα ’to Aulis’ · also object acc. of a verb of dwelling: ’inhabited Aulis’ (Αὐλίδα πετρήεσσαν ἐνέμοντο)
glossary.αὐτήν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg., as a plain pronoun: ’her’ (καὶ αὐτήν ’and her too’)
glossary.βήσεται: βαίνω — go, step; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will go’
glossary.βουλαί: βουλή — plan, counsel; fem. nom. pl.: ’plans’
glossary.βουλεύωσ: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; pres. subj. 3 pl., elided βουλεύωσ’ (= βουλεύωσι), with κεν in a relative clause: ’who may plan’
glossary.βροτοῖσιν: βροτός — mortal, mortal man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.βωμοὺς: βωμός — altar; masc. acc. pl.: ’altars’ (κατὰ βωμούς ’at the altars’)
glossary.βωμοῦ: βωμός — altar; masc. gen. sg., with ὑπαΐξας (ὑπό + ἀΐσσω): ’from beneath the altar’
glossary.γενοίατο: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. opt. 3 pl., epic -οίατο (= Attic γένοιντο), wish: ’may they be’
glossary.γερήνιος: Γερήνιος — Gerenian, standing epithet of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.; meaning uncertain — perhaps from a place Gerenia, or linked to γέρας ’honour’
glossary.γνώμεναι: γιγνώσκω — come to know, find out; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic γνῶναι): ’to know’
glossary.γνώσεαι: γιγνώσκω — come to know; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic γνώσῃ): ’you will know’
glossary.γνώσῃ: γιγνώσκω — come to know; fut. 2 sg. mid., contracted (epic γνώσεαι): ’you will know’
glossary.δαφοινὸς: δαφοινός — blood-red, tawny-red (δα- intensive + φοινός ’red’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δαῶμεν: δάω — teach; pass. learn, find out (aor. ἐδάην); aor. pass. subj. 1 pl., epic δαῶμεν, after ὄφρα: ’until we learn’
glossary.δεινὰ: δεινός — fearful, terrible, dread; neut. nom. pl., agreeing with πέλωρα
glossary.δεκάτῳ: δέκατος — tenth; neut. dat. sg., with ἔτει understood: ’in the tenth (year)’
glossary.δεξιαί: δεξιά — right hand, hand clasped in pledge (δεξιός ’right’); fem. nom. pl.: ’right hands’
glossary.δηρόν: δηρός — long, lasting; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’for long’
glossary.δράκων: δράκων — serpent, snake; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δυνάμεσθα: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 pl., epic -μεσθα (= Attic δυνάμεθα): ’we are able’ (+ inf.)
glossary.εἰδομένη: εἴδομαι — seem, make oneself like (+ dat.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg. in -όμενος, which in Homer also serves as an aor.: ’having made herself like’
glossary.εἰλέωσιν: εἰλέω — hem in, shut in, press close; pres. subj. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰλῶσιν), in a general relative clause: ’may hem in’
glossary.εἰσῆλθ: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, come in upon (+ acc.); aor. 3 sg., elided εἰσῆλθ’ (= εἰσῆλθε): ’came in upon’
glossary.εἴνατός: ἔνατος — ninth; epic εἴνατος (= Attic ἔνατος), accented before an enclitic; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’ninth’
glossary.εὑρέμεναι: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic εὑρεῖν)
glossary.θέμεναι: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic θεῖναι), with two accusatives: ’to make (you) …’
glossary.θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θαυμάζομεν: θαυμάζω — wonder at, marvel; pres. 1 pl.: ’we marvel’
glossary.θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θεσπεσίῃ: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, divine, beyond mortal scale; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by a wondrous (power)’
glossary.θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., subject: ’the god’ (common gender; may also name a goddess)
glossary.θῆκεν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., with ν-movable (= θῆκε), with double acc.: ’made (him) conspicuous’
glossary.κακότητι: κακότης — badness, baseness, cowardice; fem. dat. sg., of cause: ’through baseness’
glossary.κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’evils’
glossary.κακὸς: κακός — bad, base, cowardly; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’base’
glossary.κατήσθιε: κατεσθίω — eat up, devour; impf. 3 sg., without movable ν (= κατήσθιεν): ’was devouring’
glossary.κατακοιμηθῆναι: κατακοιμάομαι — lie down to sleep, sleep (with); aor. inf. pass.: ’to lie down’
glossary.κενεόν: κενεός — empty; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κενόν): ’empty’, ’empty-handed’
glossary.κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’fame’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a report’
glossary.κομόωντες: κομάω — wear the hair long; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κομῶντες): κάρη κομόωντες ’long-haired’
glossary.κονάβησαν: κοναβέω — ring, clang, resound; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκονάβησαν): ’rang’
glossary.κρήνην: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κρῖν: κρίνω — separate, sort, choose; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided κρῖν’ (= κρῖνε): ’sort!’
glossary.κῆρα: κήρ — doom, fate of death; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κῆρες: κήρ — death-spirit, doom of death; fem. nom. pl.: ’the death-spirits’ (a different word from κῆρ ’heart’)
glossary.λᾶαν: λᾶας — stone, rock; masc. acc. sg. (Attic λίθος)
glossary.μέλει: μέλω — be a care, be of concern (impersonal; dat. of the person, nom. of the thing); pres. 3 sg.: ’is a care to’
glossary.μήδεά: μῆδος — plan, counsel; neut. nom. pl.: ’counsels’ (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.μήδεο: μήδομαι — plan, take thought; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic μήδου): ’take thought!’
glossary.μίμνετε: μίμνω — stay, remain (= Attic μένω); pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’stay!’
glossary.μαχέονται: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted -έονται (= Attic μάχονται), or an Ionic fut. (= μαχοῦνται): ’fight’ or ’will fight’
glossary.μείνατ: μένω — stay, wait; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided μείνατ’ (= μείνατε): ’stay!’
glossary.μερόπεσσι: μέροψ — mortal, ’speech-dividing’ (conventional epithet of men; sense uncertain); masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, with the vowel doubled (= Attic μετεῖπε)
glossary.μιμνόντεσσι: μίμνω — stay, remain; pres. part. masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic μένουσι): ’for those who stay’
glossary.μῆνα: μείς, μήν — month; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a month’
glossary.μῆχος: μῆχος — means, remedy, way out; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.νεαροὶ: νεαρός — young, youthful; masc. nom. pl.: ’young ones’
glossary.νεμεσίζομ: νεμεσίζομαι — be indignant at, feel resentment at (+ acc.); pres. 1 sg., elided νεμεσίζομ’ (= νεμεσίζομαι)
glossary.νεοσσοί: νεοσσός — young bird, nestling (Attic νεοττός); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νηπιάχοις: νηπίαχος — childish, infantile (= νήπιος); masc. dat. pl., as a noun: ’childish ones’
glossary.νῆες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl. νῆες
glossary.οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’; masc. acc. pl. (οὓς παῖδας ’his own sons’)
glossary.οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’this one’
glossary.πέλωρα: πέλωρον — monster, monstrous thing; neut. nom. pl.: ’monsters’
glossary.παισὶν: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. pl., with ἐοικότες: ’like children’
glossary.πείθεό: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic πείθου): ’be guided!’ (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.πείθωνται: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded (+ dat.); pres. subj. 3 pl., in a condition with κεν: ’they obey’
glossary.περιτροπέων: περιτροπέω — revolve, come round (rare; formed on περιτρέπω ’turn round’); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= -ῶν), of the year: ’coming round’
glossary.πετάλοις: πέταλον — leaf; neut. dat. pl., with ὑπο- in ὑποπεπτηῶτες: ’beneath the leaves’
glossary.πλατάνιστον: πλατάνιστος — plane-tree; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic πλάτανος)
glossary.πλατανίστῳ: πλατάνιστος — plane-tree; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic πλάτανος), with ὑπό: ’beneath a plane-tree’
glossary.πληθύς: πληθύς — multitude, crowd; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πολεμήϊα: πολεμήϊος — of war, warlike; neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’works of war’
glossary.πολυζύγῳ: πολύζυγος — many-yoked, with many rowing-benches (ζυγόν ’yoke, thwart’); fem. dat. sg., agreeing with νηΐ
glossary.πρωΐζ: πρωΐζα — on the day before yesterday; adv., elided πρωΐζ’; with χθιζά ’yesterday and the day before’
glossary.πρόσθ: πρόσθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., elided πρόσθ’ (= πρόσθε): ’before (the others)’
glossary.πτέρυγος: πτέρυξ — wing; fem. gen. sg., partitive: ’by the wing’
glossary.πτολίπορθος: πτολίπορθος — city-sacking, sacker of cities (πτόλις = epic πόλις, πέρθω ’sack’); masc. nom. sg., epithet of Odysseus
glossary.πτολεμίξομεν: πτολεμίζω — make war, fight (epic for πολεμίζω); fut. 1 pl.: ’we shall fight’
glossary.πόνος: πόνος — toil, labour, hardship; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πότμον: πότμος — fate, doom, death; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’)
glossary.σήματα: σῆμα — sign, mark, token; neut. acc. pl.: ’signs’
glossary.σιωπᾶν: σιωπάω — be silent; pres. inf., after ἀνώγει: ’to be silent’
glossary.σμερδαλέον: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’
glossary.σμερδαλέος: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dread, fearsome; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σπονδαί: σπονδή — libation, drink-offering (pl. also a truce or pact sealed by libation); fem. nom. pl.: ’libations’
glossary.στείχοντες: στείχω — go, walk, march; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going’
glossary.στρουθοῖο: στρουθός — sparrow; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.συνθεσίαι: συνθεσίη — covenant, agreement; fem. nom. pl.: ’covenants’
glossary.σφέας: σφεῖς — they; pron., epic acc. pl. σφέας (= Attic σφᾶς), governed by κατά: κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves’
glossary.σῆμα: σῆμα — sign, mark; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, with κικλήσκουσιν understood: ’tomb’ (σῆμα Μυρίνης ’the tomb of Myrine’)
glossary.τέρας: τέρας — sign, portent, marvel; neut. acc. sg.: ’portent’
glossary.τίσασθαι: τίνυμαι (τίνω) — exact vengeance for, punish; aor. inf. mid. τίσασθαι: ’to take vengeance for’
glossary.τελεῖται: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil, accomplish; pres. pass. 3 sg.: ’is being fulfilled’
glossary.τετριγῶτας: τρίζω — squeak, cheep; perf. part. τετριγώς, masc. acc. pl. (pres. sense): ’cheeping’
glossary.τλῆτε: τλάω — endure, bear up; aor. imper. 2 pl. (aor. ἔτλην): ’endure!’
glossary.τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. τοί (= Attic οἱ), used as a relative: ’who’
glossary.τοσσαῦτ: τοσοῦτος — so great, so many; epic τοσσαῦτος (= Attic τοσοῦτος); neut. acc. pl., elided τοσσαῦτ’, acc. of duration: ’so many’
glossary.τούσδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’these’
glossary.τὼς: τώς — thus, so; epic adv. (= Attic οὕτως)
glossary.φάγε: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. 3 sg. φάγε, unaugmented (= Attic ἔφαγε); with κατά in tmesis: κατὰ … φάγε ’ate up’
glossary.φάσαν: φημί — say; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔφασαν): ’they said’
glossary.φέροντες: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’bringing’
glossary.φέρουσαι: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’bearing’, ’bearing off’
glossary.φαίνων: φαίνω — show, bring to light; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’showing’
glossary.φθινύθειν: φθινύθω — waste away, perish (epic by-form of φθίνω); pres. inf., after ἔα: ’to waste away’
glossary.φρήτρας: φρήτρη — clan, brotherhood (a subdivision of the tribe); fem. acc. pl., distributive with κατά: κατὰ φρήτρας ’by clans’
glossary.φρήτρη: φρήτρη — clan, brotherhood; fem. nom. sg.: ’clan’
glossary.φρήτρηφιν: φρήτρη — clan, brotherhood; fem. dat. sg. with the epic suffix -φιν (= Attic φρήτρᾳ): ’clan’
glossary.φόνον: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φύλοις: φῦλον — tribe, race; neut. dat. pl.: ’tribes’
glossary.φῦλα: φῦλον — tribe, race; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’tribes’
glossary.χειμέριαι: χειμέριος — wintry, stormy; fem. nom. pl., agreeing with ἄελλαι
glossary.χθιζά: χθιζά — yesterday; adv. (neut. pl. of χθιζός ’of yesterday’)
glossary.χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a time’
glossary.χῆραί: χῆρος, χήρα — bereft, widowed; fem. nom. pl.: ’widowed’ (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.ψεῦδος: ψεῦδος — falsehood, lie; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’a falsehood’
glossary.ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, bright, radiant; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγοράασθε: ἀγοράομαι — speak in assembly, harangue; pres. 2 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀγορᾶσθε)
glossary.ἀκροτάτῳ: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; superl. ἀκρότατος, masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀλαπάξεις: ἀλαπάζω — sack, lay waste; fut. 2 sg.: ’you will lay waste’
glossary.ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’to one another’
glossary.ἀλόχοιο: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀμφεποτᾶτο: ἀμφιποτάομαι — flutter around; impf. 3 sg., epic contracted -ᾶτο: ’fluttered around’
glossary.ἀμφιαχυῖαν: ἀμφιάχω — cry out around, shriek about (rare; sense taken from the formation); perf. part. fem. acc. sg. ἀμφιαχυῖα: ’shrieking around’
glossary.ἀνιηθέντα: ἀνιάω — grieve, distress; aor. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’distressed’
glossary.ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’
glossary.ἀπόβλητον: ἀπόβλητος — to be thrown away, cast off; neut. nom. sg., predicate (ἀποβάλλω): ’to be thrown away’
glossary.ἀρήγῃ: ἀρήγω — help, aid (+ dat.); pres. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause: ’may help’
glossary.ἀρίζηλον: ἀρίζηλος — conspicuous, very clear; masc. acc. sg., predicate with θῆκεν: ’conspicuous’
glossary.ἀστεμφέα: ἀστεμφής — unshaken, firm; fem. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with βουλήν
glossary.ἀστράπτων: ἀστράπτω — flash lightning; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’flashing lightning’
glossary.ἀσχαλάαν: ἀσχαλάω — be distressed, chafe, be vexed; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀσχαλᾶν): ’to chafe’
glossary.ἀσχαλάᾳ: ἀσχαλάω — be distressed, chafe, be vexed; pres. 3 sg. act., epic diectasis (= Attic ἀσχαλᾷ): ’chafes’
glossary.ἀφραδίῃ: ἀφραδίη — folly, thoughtlessness; fem. dat. sg., of cause: ’through folly’
glossary.ἀϋσάντων: ἀΰω — shout, cry out; aor. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’shouting’
glossary.ἁπτέσθω: ἅπτομαι — touch, lay hold of (+ gen.); pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him touch’
glossary.ἄελλαι: ἄελλα — storm, blast of wind; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄκρητοι: ἄκρητος — unmixed (of wine); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with σπονδαί
glossary.ἄνεῳ: ἄνεως — silent, speechless; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄνυσις: ἄνυσις — accomplishment, achievement; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄργεος: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
glossary.ἄρχευ: ἄρχω — lead, rule (+ dat.); imper. 2 sg., elided ἄρχευ’ (probably ἄρχευε, a by-form of ἄρχε; formation uncertain): ’lead!’
glossary.ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐγένεσθε: γίγνομαι — become; aor. 2 pl.: ’you became, have become’
glossary.ἐθέλουσιν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable: ’they wish’
glossary.ἐκτελέουσιν: ἐκτελέω — bring to completion, fulfil; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐκτελοῦσιν; could also be a fut., ’will fulfil’): ’they fulfil’
glossary.ἐλέγχιστον: ἐλεγχής — shameful, disgraceful; superl. ἐλέγχιστος, masc. acc. sg., predicate with σε: ’most shameful’
glossary.ἐλεεινὰ: ἐλεεινός — pitiable, piteous; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’pitiably’
glossary.ἐλελιξάμενος: ἐλελίζω — whirl, coil; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having coiled himself’
glossary.ἐνάτη: ἔνατος — ninth (epic also εἴνατος); fem. nom. sg., predicate: ’ninth’
glossary.ἐναίσιμα: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, auspicious (of signs); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐοικότες: ἔοικα (perf. with pres. force) — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
glossary.ἐπέεσσ: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic ἐπέεσσι, elided ἐπέεσσ’ (= Attic ἔπεσι): ’with words’
glossary.ἐπέπιθμεν: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα trust; plpf. 1 pl. ἐπέπιθμεν, epic (+ dat.): ’we trusted’
glossary.ἐπίσπῃ: ἐφέπω — come upon, meet with, pursue; aor. subj. 3 sg. ἐπίσπῃ (aor. ἔσπον), in a purpose clause: ’may meet with’
glossary.ἐπαινήσαντες: ἐπαινέω — approve, praise; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having approved’
glossary.ἐπειγέσθω: ἐπείγω — press, urge; mid. hurry, hasten; pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let (him) hasten’
glossary.ἐπιδέξι: ἐπιδέξιος — on the right hand (the lucky side); neut. pl. ἐπιδέξια as adv., elided ἐπιδέξι’: ’on the right’
glossary.ἐπιφρασσαίατο: ἐπιφράζομαι — notice, take note of, consider; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -αίατο (= Attic ἐπιφράσαιντο): ’might take note of’
glossary.ἐριδαίνομεν: ἐριδαίνω — quarrel, strive, contend; pres. 1 pl.: ’we quarrel’
glossary.ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.: ’good’
glossary.ἐτεὸν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
glossary.ἐφάνη: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. pass. 3 sg., augmented (beside unaugmented φάνη): ’appeared’
glossary.ἑσταότες: ἵστημι — set up; perf. stand; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic ἑσταότες (= Attic ἑστῶτες): ’standing’
glossary.ἔβαινον: βαίνω — go, step; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they went’ (ἐν … ἔβαινον ’they went aboard’)
glossary.ἔθ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided ἔθ’ before a rough breathing (ἔθ’ ὡς): ’still’
glossary.ἔτεα: ἔτος — year; neut. pl., epic uncontracted ἔτεα (= Attic ἔτη), acc. of duration: ’years’
glossary.ἔφηνε: φαίνω — show, make appear; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’showed, revealed’
glossary.ἔῃσι: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ἔῃσι (= Attic ᾖ): ’may be’
glossary.ἕνα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. acc. sg.: ’a single’ (ἕνα μῆνα ’a single month’); ’one’ (ἕνα καὶ δύο ’one and two’)
glossary.ἕρδομεν: ἕρδω — do, perform; offer (a sacrifice) (= ῥέζω); impf. 1 pl.: ’we were offering’
glossary.ἕρξῃς: ἕρδω — do, perform (= ῥέζω); aor. subj. 2 sg., after εἰ … κεν: ’you do’
glossary.ἠγερέθοντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. mid. 3 pl., epic -εθ- formation (= Attic ἠγείροντο): ’were gathering’
glossary.ἡγεμόνων: ἡγεμών — leader, guide; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the leaders’
glossary.ἱεροὺς: ἱερός — holy, sacred; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἱπποβότοιο: ἱππόβοτος — horse-pasturing, breeding horses; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with a place-name: ’horse-pasturing (Argos)’
glossary.ἱππότα: ἱππότα — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α (= ἱππότης)
glossary.ἴαχον: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’they shouted’
glossary.ὀδυρομένη: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn for; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
glossary.ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic Ὀδυσσῆος (double σ, metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆος)
glossary.ὀδύρονται: ὀδύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. 3 pl.: ’they lament’
glossary.ὀλεῖται: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; fut. 3 sg. mid., contracted (from ὀλέεται): ’will perish’
glossary.ὀρινομένη: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; pass. be stirred; pres. part. pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’stirred up’
glossary.ὀψιτέλεστον: ὀψιτέλεστος — fulfilled late, late to be accomplished; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέρας
glossary.ὁρμήματά: ὅρμημα — rush, effort, striving; neut. acc. pl.: ’strivings’ (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.ὄζῳ: ὄζος — branch, bough; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ὄρουσεν: ὀρούω — rush, dart, spring; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable: ’rushed’
glossary.ὄψιμον: ὄψιμος — late; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέρας: ’late’
glossary.ὅθεν: ὅθεν — from where, whence; relative adv.
glossary.ὅου: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg., epic ὅου (= Attic οὗ): ’whose’
glossary.ὑπέσταν: ὑφίστημι — undertake, promise; aor. 3 pl. intrans., epic ὑπέσταν (= Attic ὑπέστησαν): ’they undertook’
glossary.ὑπαΐξας: ὑπαΐσσω — dart out from under; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’darting out from beneath’
glossary.ὑπερμενέα: ὑπερμενής — of surpassing strength; masc. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with Κρονίωνα
glossary.ὑποπεπτηῶτες: ὑποπτήσσω — crouch beneath, cower; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic ὑποπεπτηῶτες (perf. πεπτηώς): ’crouching beneath’
glossary.ὠκυπόροισιν: ὠκύπορος — swift-faring (of ships); fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.αἰγίδ: αἰγίς — aegis, Athena’s goat-skin shield; fem. acc. sg., elided (αἰγίδ’ = αἰγίδα)
glossary.αἰγίοχος: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing (epithet of Zeus; sense disputed); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰειγενετάων: αἰειγενέτης — ever-born, everlasting; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), epithet of θεῶν ’gods’
glossary.αἰθέρι: αἰθήρ — upper air, bright sky; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.αἰθέρος: αἰθήρ — the bright upper air, sky; masc. gen. sg. (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the upper air’)
glossary.αἰθαλόεν: αἰθαλόεις — sooty, smoky, blackened with smoke; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μέλαθρον
glossary.αἲ: αἴ (epic = εἰ) — if, would that; particle introducing a wish + opt. (αἲ γάρ ’would that’)
glossary.αἴαντε: Αἴας — Ajax; masc. dual nom./acc.: ’the two Ajaxes’ (the Telamonian and the Locrian)
glossary.αὐγή: αὐγή — beam, ray, gleam of light; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐτόματος: αὐτόματος — acting of one’s own accord, unbidden; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βάλλει: βάλλω — throw, cast, hurl; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’casts, throws’
glossary.βαλέειν: βάλλω — throw, cast, let fall; aor. inf., epic βαλέειν (= Attic βαλεῖν)
glossary.βουλεύσομεν: βουλεύω — plan, take counsel; aor. subj. 1 pl., short vowel (= Attic βουλεύσωμεν), after εἰ without κε; or fut. indic. 1 pl.
glossary.βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ’good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός)
glossary.βοῦν: βοῦς — ox, cow; acc. sg. (masc. ’ox’, fem. ’cow’)
glossary.γένωνται: γίγνομαι — come to be, arrive, be; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., with ὅτ’ ἂν: ’whenever they come to be’
glossary.γέροντας: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.γίγνεται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen, arise; pres. 3 sg.: ’comes into being, grows’
glossary.γεράνων: γέρανος — crane (the bird); fem. gen. pl.
glossary.γλαφυρῇσι: γλαφυρός — hollow; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.δέκτο: δέχομαι — receive, accept; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, athematic form (= Attic ἐδέξατο): ’accepted’
glossary.δήθ: δηθά (elided δήθ’) — for long, long since; adv., intensified by δή: ’for so long now’
glossary.δαΐξαι: δαΐζω — cleave, rend, tear apart; aor. inf. act.: ’to rend’
glossary.δεῖπνον: δεῖπνον — meal, main meal; neut. acc. sg. of the goal: ’to the meal’ (ἐπὶ δεῖπνον) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’a meal’ (of horses, ’fodder’)
glossary.δηΐοιο: δήϊος — hostile, ravaging (of fire); neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with πυρός
glossary.δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
glossary.δι: διά — through; prep. + gen. or acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through’ (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the sky’)
glossary.διέσσυτο: διασεύομαι — rush through, dart through; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented, epic double σ: ’darted through’
glossary.διακρινέει: διακρίνω — part, separate, decide between; fut. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic διακρινεῖ): ’will part’
glossary.διοτρεφέες: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured (of kings); masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic διοτρεφεῖς)
glossary.δουλιχοδείρων: δουλιχόδειρος — long-necked; masc. gen. pl., epithet of κύκνων ’swans’
glossary.δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk; spear (a shaft of wood); neut. nom./acc. sg. (gen. δουρός)
glossary.δότω: δίδωμι — give; aor. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him give’
glossary.δῦναι: δύω — go down, sink, set; aor. inf. act. (root aorist), of the sun: ’to set’
glossary.εἶεν: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may (they) be’ (αἲ γὰρ … μοι … εἶεν ’would that I had …’) · in a remote condition: ’if there were’
glossary.θέσθω: τίθημι — put, place; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him set (in order)’
glossary.θηξάσθω: θήγω — whet, sharpen; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him sharpen (his own)’
glossary.θύρετρα: θύρετρον — door, doorway; neut. nom./acc. pl. (the plural for the doors of one house)
glossary.θύσανοι: θύσανος — tassel, fringe; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.θᾶσσον: ταχύς — swift; comparative adv. θᾶσσον (= Attic θᾶττον) ’more swiftly, the sooner’
glossary.θῦνον: θύνω — rush, dash, charge; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθυνον)
glossary.κάπνισσάν: καπνίζω — make smoke, kindle fires; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic double σ (= ἐκάπνισαν), accented before the enclitic τε
glossary.κίκλησκεν: καλέω — call, summon; impf. 3 sg. of the reduplicated κικλήσκω, unaugmented (= ἐκίκλησκεν): ’was summoning’
glossary.κακοῦ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. sg., substantive: ’of evil, of trouble’
glossary.καμεῖται: κάμνω — toil, grow weary; fut. 3 sg. (middle in form): ’will grow tired’
glossary.καρδίῃ: καρδίη — heart; fem. dat. sg., Ionic (= Attic καρδίᾳ), of place: ’in the heart’
glossary.κατέκαιον: κατακαίω — burn up, burn down; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’were burning up’
glossary.καϋστρίου: Κάϋστριος — the Cayster, river of Lydia (also Κάϋστρος); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κεδασθέντες: κεδάννυμι (= σκεδάννυμι) — scatter, disperse; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’scattered’
glossary.κελαινεφὲς: κελαινεφής — dark with cloud, black-clouded (epithet of Zeus); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.κηρύσσοντες: κηρύσσω — proclaim as herald, summon; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’proclaiming’
glossary.κλαγγηδὸν: κλαγγηδόν — with clanging cry, noisily; adv. (κλαγγή ’clang’ + -δόν)
glossary.κονάβιζε: κοναβίζω — ring, resound, clatter; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’rang’
glossary.κονίῃσιν: κονία — dust, ashes; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.κορυφῇς: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. dat. pl., epic short -ῇς (= κορυφῇσι, Attic κορυφαῖς)
glossary.κρίνοντες: κρίνω — separate, sort out, marshal; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’marshalling’
glossary.κρινώμεθ: κρίνω — separate, decide; mid. fight it out, contend; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., elided (κρινώμεθ’ = κρινώμεθα), in purpose after ὥς κε
glossary.λαζοίατο: λάζομαι — take hold of, seize; pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= Attic -οιντο), in a wish: ’may they seize’
glossary.λείπει: λείπω — leave, forsake, abandon; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’leaves’
glossary.λεγώμεθα: λέγω — speak, talk (mid. perhaps ’tarry’; sense disputed); pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortatory: ’let us talk’
glossary.λειμών: λειμών — meadow, grassland; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε · also fem. gen. sg., governed by εἰδότε: ’skilled in all (fighting)’
glossary.μέγιστε: μέγας — great; superlative μέγιστος, masc. voc. sg., address: ’greatest’
glossary.μέλαθρον: μέλαθρον — roof-beam, roof; the roof standing for the house; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.μίαν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; numeral, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μαχεσσάμεθ: μάχομαι (epic μαχέομαι) — fight, quarrel; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic σσ, elided (μαχεσσάμεθ’ = μαχεσσάμεθα)
glossary.μεδέσθω: μέδομαι — be mindful of, take thought for (+ gen.); pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him heed’
glossary.μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μετέσσεται: μέτειμι — be among, be present; fut. 3 sg., epic double σ (= Attic μετέσται): ’there will be among’
glossary.μηκέτι: μηκέτι — no longer, not any more; neg. adv., used with subj./imper. in prohibitions
glossary.μιμνάζειν: μιμνάζω — linger, stay behind, hang back; pres. inf. act. (by-form of μίμνω)
glossary.μυρίοι: μυρίος — countless, numberless; masc. nom. pl. (later ’ten thousand’)
glossary.μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
glossary.μὰν: μάν — truly, indeed; epic particle (= Attic μήν); ἦ μάν ’truly indeed’
glossary.μῶλον: μῶλος — toil of battle, struggle; masc. acc. sg. (μῶλον Ἄρηος ’the toil of Ares’)
glossary.νέστορα: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; acc. sg.
glossary.ναίων: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’dwelling’
glossary.νείκεα: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νείκη)
glossary.νικᾷς: νικάω — conquer, win, surpass; pres. 2 sg. act. + dat. of respect
glossary.νοήσω: νοέω — perceive, notice, catch sight of; aor. subj. 1 sg., short vowel, with κε in a general clause: ’whomever I notice’
glossary.ξυνάγωμεν: συνάγω (epic ξυνάγω) — bring together, join; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that we may join’
glossary.οἰωνούς: οἰωνός — bird (of prey), bird of omen; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.οὔρεος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. sg., epic οὔρεος (= Attic ὄρους)
glossary.παγχρύσεοι: πάγχρυσος — all of gold, wholly golden; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic πάγχρυσοι)
glossary.παιφάσσουσα: παιφάσσω — dart about, rush glittering; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’darting’
glossary.παμφανόωσα: παμφανάω — shine all over, gleam brightly; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic diectasis (= Attic παμφανῶσα)
glossary.παναχαιῶν: Πανάχαιοι — all the Achaeans, i.e. the whole Greek host; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.παντοίων: παντοῖος — of all kinds, of every sort; masc./neut. gen. pl.
glossary.παυσωλή: παυσωλή — pause, respite, rest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πενταέτηρον: πενταέτηρος — five years old; adj. of two endings, masc./fem. acc. sg., agreeing with βοῦν: ’five-year-old’
glossary.περθομένη: πέρθω — sack, destroy; pres. part. pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’being sacked’
glossary.περιστήσαντο: περιίστημι — set around, place around; aor. 3 pl. mid., transitive: ’stood (it) round’
glossary.πετεηνῶν: πετεηνός — winged; pl. as noun, birds; masc. gen. pl., epic (= Attic πετεινῶν), with ὀρνίθων
glossary.πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)
glossary.ποτῶνται: ποτάομαι — fly about, flit; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’fly to and fro’
glossary.πρηνέες: πρηνής — headlong, face down; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic πρηνεῖς)
glossary.πρηνὲς: πρηνής — headlong, face down; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’headlong’
glossary.προβλῆτι: πρόβλης — jutting out, projecting; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with σκοπέλῳ
glossary.προκαθιζόντων: προκαθίζω — sit down in front, settle down in advance; pres. part. gen. pl., gen. absolute: ’as they settle’
glossary.προχέοντο: προχέω — pour forth; mid./pass. stream forth; impf. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented (= προεχέοντο): ’poured forth’
glossary.πρῆσαι: πίμπρημι (πρήθω) — burn, set on fire; aor. inf. act.: ’to burn’
glossary.πτερύγεσσι: πτέρυξ — wing; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πτέρυξι)
glossary.πόλεμος: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πόνον: πόνος — toil, labor, trouble; acc. sg.
glossary.σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.σκαμάνδριον: Σκαμάνδριος — of the Scamander, Scamandrian; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with πεδίον
glossary.σκαμανδρίῳ: Σκαμάνδριος — of the Scamander, Scamandrian; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with λειμῶνι
glossary.σκοπέλῳ: σκόπελος — rock, crag, cliff; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.στήθεσφιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. in epic -φιν, a case ending serving as gen. or dat. (= Attic στήθους, στήθει); after ἀμφί: ’about the chest’
glossary.στυγερῷ: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.συμφράδμονες: συμφράδμων — counselling together; as noun, fellow-counsellor; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.σχίζῃσιν: σχίζα — split wood, billet, log; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.τελαμὼν: τελαμών — broad strap, shield-strap, baldric; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
glossary.τιταίνων: τιταίνω — stretch, strain; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’straining’
glossary.τοιοῦτοι: τοιοῦτος — of such a kind, such; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
glossary.τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’)
glossary.φαίνεται: φαίνω — show, make appear; pres. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’appears, is plain to see’
glossary.φυγέειν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic φυγεῖν)
glossary.φυγεῖν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. inf. act. (Attic form, = epic φυγέειν): ’to flee’
glossary.χαλεπαίνων: χαλεπαίνω — be harsh, be angry, rage; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’in anger’
glossary.χθὼν: χθών — earth, ground; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀΐδηλον: ἀΐδηλος — destructive, baneful (exact sense debated); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγήρων: ἀγήρως — ageless, never growing old; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγαλλόμενα: ἀγάλλομαι — exult, glory in (+ dat.); pres. part. mid. neut. nom. pl.: ’exulting’
glossary.ἀγειρόντων: ἀγείρω — gather, collect; pres. imper. 3 pl. act.: ’let them gather’
glossary.ἀγορῇ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. dat. sg. (Attic ἀγορᾷ)
glossary.ἀδελφεὸν: ἀδελφεός — brother (epic form = Attic ἀδελφός); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
glossary.ἀθρόοι: ἀθρόος — crowded together, all together; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀκτῇ: ἀκτή — headland, promontory, shore; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ῇ)
glossary.ἀμέγαρτον: ἀμέγαρτος — unenviable, wretched, dreadful; adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμβαλλώμεθα: ἀναβάλλομαι — put off, delay; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., epic ἀμβ- for ἀναβ-: ’let us put off’
glossary.ἀμπείραντες: ἀναπείρω — pierce through, spit (meat); aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic ἀμπ- for ἀναπ-: ’having spitted’
glossary.ἀμφιβρότης: ἀμφιβρότη — covering the man on both sides (of a shield); fem. gen. sg., agreeing with ἀσπίδος
glossary.ἀνάβλησις: ἀνάβλησις — putting off, delay; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνθεμόεντι: ἀνθεμόεις — flowered, decorated with flowers; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀνστάντες: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; intrans. aor. part. masc. nom. pl., epic apocope (ἀνστάντες = ἀναστάντες)
glossary.ἀντιβίοις: ἀντίβιος — hostile, face to face, opposing; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσι
glossary.ἀπίθησεν: ἀπιθέω — disobey; aor. 3 sg. act. (= Attic ἀπείθησεν); with οὐκ: ’did not disobey’
glossary.ἀπρήκτους: ἄπρηκτος — unavailing, fruitless, without result; fem. acc. pl. (Attic ἄπρακτος)
glossary.ἀριστῆας: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief, champion; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἀσίω: Ἄσιος — Asian, of Asia (the Lydian region); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with λειμῶνι
glossary.ἀφύλλοισιν: ἄφυλλος — leafless, stripped of leaves; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), agreeing with σχίζῃσιν
glossary.ἁλοῦσά: ἁλίσκομαι — be taken, be captured; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε: ’having been taken’
glossary.ἄλληκτον: ἄλληκτος — unceasing, not to be stopped; adj. of two endings, neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σθένος
glossary.ἄνθεα: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἄνθη)
glossary.ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη)
glossary.ἄρηϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
glossary.ἄρκιον: ἄρκιος — sufficing, sure, safe; neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject
glossary.ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling (ἀ- + root of ’say’); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐΰξοον: εὔξοος — well-polished, smooth; neut. nom./acc. sg., epic ἐΰξοον
glossary.ἐγγυαλίζει: ἐγγυαλίζω — put into the hands of, deliver, grant; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐγείρομεν: ἐγείρω — rouse, awaken; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., short vowel, in a purpose clause after ὄφρα κε: ’that we may rouse’
glossary.ἐλθών: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
glossary.ἐπεκραίαινε: ἐπικραιαίνω — bring to pass, fulfil (a prayer); impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was fulfilling’
glossary.ἐπιφλέγει: ἐπιφλέγω — blaze over, set ablaze, consume; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἐπονεῖτο: πονέομαι — toil, be busy with; impf. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐρίτιμον: ἐρίτιμος — much honoured, very precious; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐρχομένων: ἔρχομαι — go, come, march; pres. part. mid. gen. pl. masc.: ’of those going’
glossary.ἐσσεῖται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic ἐσσεῖται (= Attic ἔσται)
glossary.ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’
glossary.ἐϋπλεκέες: ἐϋπλεκής — well-plaited, well-woven; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἑκατόμβοιος: ἑκατόμβοιος — worth a hundred oxen; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑκτόρεον: Ἑκτόρειος — of Hector, Hector’s; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χιτῶνα
glossary.ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
glossary.ἔρεζε: ῥέζω — do, perform; of sacrifice, offer (+ dat. of the god); impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἔρεζε = ἔρρεζε)
glossary.ἔριδας: ἔρις — strife, quarrel; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔρχεσθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθε): ’go!’
glossary.ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc., accented ἔς before an enclitic
glossary.ἔχουσ: ἔχω — have, hold, carry; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἔχουσ’ = ἔχουσα): ’holding’
glossary.ἕκαθεν: ἑκάς (ἕκαθεν) — far off, from afar; adv., epic -θεν (= Attic πόρρωθεν)
glossary.ἕκτον: ἕκτος — sixth; ordinal, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἕλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἵλοντο): ’took (for themselves)’
glossary.ἠβαιόν: ἠβαιός — little, small; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, almost always with a negative: ’not even a little’
glossary.ἠβαιὸν: ἠβαιός — little, small; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, almost always with a negative: ’not even a little’
glossary.ἠερέθονται: ἠερέθομαι — hover, dangle, sway in the air; pres. 3 pl. mid./pass.: ’dangle’
glossary.ἠμύσειε: ἠμύω — sink down, bow, collapse; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., potential with κε: ’would collapse’
glossary.ἡμετέρῃσιν: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), agreeing with χερσίν
glossary.ἡφαίστοιο: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; by metonymy, fire; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἦρχον: ἄρχω — begin, lead, rule; impf. 1 sg.: ’I began, I led’ · also impf. 3 pl., + gen.: ’were leading’ (Βοιωτῶν … ἦρχον)
glossary.ἰδομενῆα: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.ἱέρευσε: ἱερεύω — sacrifice, slaughter (a victim); aor. 3 sg. act.: ’sacrificed’
glossary.ἱδρώσει: ἱδρόω — sweat; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will sweat’
glossary.ἱρά: ἱερός (Ionic ἱρός) — sacred; neut. pl. as noun, offerings; neut. acc. pl. (= Attic ἱερά)
glossary.ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
glossary.ἵπποισιν: ἵππος — horse; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic ἵπποις)
glossary.ἷκε: ἵκω — come, arrive at, reach; impf. 3 sg. (= ἷκεν), with long ι: ’reached’
glossary.ὀδὰξ: ὀδάξ — with the teeth, biting; adv.
glossary.ὀρέοντο: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; mid. rise up, hasten; ὀρέοντο, Homeric 3 pl. mid. (impf. in force): ’rose up, hastened’
glossary.ὅσσά: ὅσος — as great, as many as; neut. nom. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὅσα): ’as many as’
glossary.ὑπείρεχον: ὑπερέχω — hold over, hold above (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl. act., epic ὑπείρεχον (= Attic ὑπερεῖχον)
glossary.ὑψηλῇ: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg. · also Ὕλη — Hyle, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὠκυπόδεσσιν: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ὠκύποσι), agreeing with ἵπποισιν
glossary.ὥρῃ: ὥρα — season, time; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
glossary.ᾔδεε: οἶδα — know; plpf. (impf. in sense) 3 sg., epic ᾔδεε (= Attic ᾔδει): ’knew’
glossary.ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ῥωγαλέον: ῥωγαλέος — rent, torn, in tatters; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χιτῶνα
glossary.αἰδοίη: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰπόλια: αἰπόλιον — herd of goats; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰπὺ: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; adj., neut. acc. sg. · also Αἰπύ — Aepy, a town of Messenia; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰχμηταὶ: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.αἴγιναν: Αἴγινα — Aegina, island in the Saronic Gulf; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.: ’which’ (with τε, in a simile)
glossary.αὐγειὰς: Αὐγειαί — Augeiae, a Locrian town; fem. acc. pl. · also Αὐγειαί — Augeiae, a Laconian town; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βαθὺν: βαθύς — deep; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βοαγρίου: Βοάγριος — the Boagrius, a river of Locris; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.βοιωτῶν: Βοιωτοί — the Boeotians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.βόεσσι: βοῦς — ox, cow; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic βουσί): ’among the cows’
glossary.βῆσσάν: Βῆσσα — Bessa, a Locrian town (also βῆσσα ’wooded glen’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γλαφυραὶ: γλαφυρός — hollow; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.γλισᾶντ: Γλίσας — Glisas, a Boeotian town; acc. sg., elided (Γλισᾶντ’ = Γλίσαντα)
glossary.γραῖάν: Γραῖα — Graea, a Boeotian town (also γραῖα ’old woman’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δίου: Δῖον — Dium, a town of Euboea; neut. gen. sg. (Δίου)
glossary.δαυλίδα: Δαυλίς — Daulis, a Phocian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δηΐων: δήϊος — hostile; as noun, an enemy; masc. gen. pl., epic δηΐων (= Attic δηίων)
glossary.διακρίνωσιν: διακρίνω — separate, sort apart; pres. subj. 3 pl., in a general simile (subj. without κε in the comparison clause)
glossary.διαρραῖσαι: διαρραίω — shatter utterly, destroy; aor. inf. act.: ’to shatter’
glossary.διεκόσμεον: διακοσμέω — marshal, set in order; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic διεκόσμουν)
glossary.διομήδης: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δυοκαίδεκα: δυοκαίδεκα — twelve; numeral, indeclinable (= Attic δώδεκα)
glossary.δόμῳ: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εἰαρινῇ: εἰαρινός — of spring; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἐαρινῇ)
glossary.εἰλέσιον: Εἰλέσιον — Eilesion, a Boeotian town; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.εἰρέτριάν: Ἐρέτρια — Eretria, a city of Euboea; fem. acc. sg., epic Εἰρέτρια (= Attic Ἐρέτρια)
glossary.εἰσαναβᾶσα: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having gone up’
glossary.εἶχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl. (the form also serves 1 sg.): ’they held, occupied’ (of places)
glossary.εὐβοίης: Εὔβοια — Euboea, the long island off Attica; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.εὐρύαλος: Εὐρύαλος — Euryalus, an Argive leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐρύχορον: εὐρύχορος — with wide dancing-places, spacious; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὔβοιαν: Εὔβοια — Euboea, the long island off Attica; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.εὔτρησίν: Εὔτρησις — Eutresis, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.ζείδωρος: ζείδωρος — grain-giving (of ploughland); adj., fem. nom. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’giving ζειά (a kind of grain)’, anciently also ’life-giving’
glossary.ζώνην: ζώνη — belt, girdle, waist; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect
glossary.θέσπειαν: Θέσπεια — Thespeia, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θίσβην: Θίσβη — Thisbe, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θεαί: θεά — goddess; fem. nom. pl., predicate: ’goddesses’
glossary.θοοὶ: θοός — swift, quick; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.θρέψε: τρέφω — nourish, rear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθρεψε)
glossary.θρόνιον: Θρόνιον — Thronium, a Locrian town; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.θωρήσσοντο: θωρήσσω — arm with a breastplate; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic θωρήττω): ’armed themselves’
glossary.θώρηκας: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κάρυστον: Κάρυστος — Carystus, a town of Euboea; acc. sg.
glossary.κήρινθόν: Κήρινθος — Cerinthus, a town of Euboea; acc. sg. (accent from enclitic)
glossary.κίον: κίω — go, move; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔκιον; Attic uses ἔρχομαι, εἶμι)
glossary.καλλίαρόν: Κάλλιαρος — Calliarus, a Locrian town; acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.καπανῆος: Καπανεύς — Capaneus, father of Sthenelus; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.κεφαλὴν: κεφαλή — head; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect
glossary.κηφισοῖο: Κηφισός — the Cephisus, a river of Phocis; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.κηφισὸν: Κηφισός — the Cephisus, a river of Phocis; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κλονίος: Κλονίος — Clonius, a Boeotian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κοίρανοι: κοίρανος — ruler, lord, commander; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κορώνειαν: Κορώνεια — Coroneia, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κοσμῆσαι: κοσμέω — arrange, marshal, set in order; aor. inf. act., limiting inf.: ’in marshalling’
glossary.κρατερῷ: κρατερός — strong, mighty; adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κρῖσάν: Κρῖσα — Crisa, a Phocian town; fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.κυπάρισσον: Κυπάρισσος — Cyparissus, a Phocian town (also ’cypress’); acc. sg.
glossary.κόλπον: κόλπος — bosom, hollow, gulf (of the sea); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κώπας: Κῶπαι — Copae, a Boeotian town on Lake Copais; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κῦνόν: Κῦνος — Cynus, a Locrian town; acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.λάθρῃ: λάθρῃ — secretly, by stealth; adv. (dat. sg. used adverbially)
glossary.λήϊτος: Λήϊτος — Leitus, a Boeotian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λίλαιαν: Λίλαια — Lilaea, a Phocian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λινοθώρηξ: λινοθώρηξ — wearing a linen corselet; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λοκρῶν: Λοκροί — the Locrians; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.μάσητά: Μάσης — Mases, a town of the Argolid; acc. sg. (Μάσητα, accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.μέλαιναι: μέλας — black, dark; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.μένεα: μένος — might, spirit, fury; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic μένη)
glossary.μίδειαν: Μίδεια — Mideia, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μείων: μείων — smaller, less (comparative of μικρός); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεγαθύμου: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μεγαλήτορος: μεγαλήτωρ — great-hearted, great of spirit (μέγας + ἦτορ ’heart’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μεδεῶνά: Μεδεών — Medeon, a Boeotian town; acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.μελίῃσι: μελίη — ash tree; ash-wood spear; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.μεμαῶτες: μέμονα — be eager, strive; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (μεμαώς, μεμαῶτ-), with present sense: ’eager’
glossary.μενεσθεύς: Μενεσθεύς — Menestheus, the Athenian leader; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεταπρέπει: μεταπρέπω — be conspicuous among, stand out among; pres. 3 sg., + dat.
glossary.μηκιστέος: Μηκιστεύς — Mecisteus, father of Euryalus; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.μιγέωσιν: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. pass. subj. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (μιγέωσιν = Attic μιγῶσιν): ’have mingled’
glossary.μινύειον: Μινύειος — Minyan, of the Minyae; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μνησαίαθ: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. call to mind, remember; aor. opt. 3 pl. mid., elided (μνησαίαθ’ = μνησαίατο): ’might call to mind’
glossary.μοῦσαι: Μοῦσα — Muse, goddess of song; fem. nom. pl. · also fem. voc. pl., in address: ’Muses’
glossary.μυθήσομαι: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak of; fut. 1 sg., or short-vowel aor. subj.; with οὐκ ἂν: ’I could not tell’
glossary.μυιάων: μυῖα — fly; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.μυκαλησσόν: Μυκαλησσός — Mycalessus, a Boeotian town; acc. sg.
glossary.νέες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl., epic νέες (= Attic νῆες)
glossary.ναιετάασκον: ναιετάω — dwell, inhabit; impf. 3 pl., iterative -ασκον and uncontracted (= Attic ᾤκουν): ’used to dwell in’
glossary.ναυβολίδαο: Ναυβολίδης — son of Naubolus (patronymic); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ναῖον: ναίω — dwell in, inhabit; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔναιον), + acc.
glossary.νηῷ: ναός — temple, shrine; masc. dat. sg., Ionic νηός (= Attic νεώς, dat. νεῷ)
glossary.νομῷ: νομός — pasture, grazing-ground; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.νῆάς: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
glossary.νῖσάν: Νῖσα — Nisa, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε)
glossary.οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; neut. acc. sg.: ’only, nothing but’
glossary.πάρεστέ: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. 2 pl. (accent from enclitic τε): ’you are present’
glossary.πέρην: πέρην — across, on the far side; adv., used as prep. + gen.: ’across from’

glossary.αὐτοκασίγνητος: αὐτοκασίγνητος — own brother, full brother (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.

glossary.κῶν: Κῶς — Cos, an island of the Aegean; fem. acc. sg. (Κῶν)

glossary.οὗτοι: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. pl.: ’these’
glossary.πέλασσεν: πελάζω — bring near, drive to; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ἐπέλασεν), + dat.
glossary.πήλιον: Πήλιον — Pelion, mountain in Thessaly; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.παραὶ: παρά (epic παραί) — beside, along; prep. + acc.: ’beside’
glossary.παῖδε: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. dual: ’two sons’

glossary.ποθέοντες: ποθέω — long for, miss; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ποθοῦντες)

glossary.πρωτεσίλαος: Πρωτεσίλαος — Protesilaus, a leader of the men of Phylace and its neighbours, killed as he leapt from his ship; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρωτεσιλάου: Πρωτεσίλαος — Protesilaus, a leader of the men of Phylace and its neighbours; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πρόθοος: Πρόθοος — Prothous, leader of the Magnetes; masc. nom. sg.

glossary.τέρποντο: τέρπω — delight; mid. take pleasure, amuse oneself; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’amused themselves’
glossary.τείχεα: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic τείχη)
glossary.τενθρηδόνος: Τενθρηδών — Tenthredon, father of Prothous; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τιτάνοιό: Τίτανος — Titanus, taken as a place-name (τίτανος is also ‘chalk, gypsum’; sense uncertain); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.τιταρησσὸν: Τιταρησσός — the Titaressus, a river of Thessaly; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τρίκκην: Τρίκκη — Tricca, a town of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τρηχῖνα: Τρηχίς — Trachis, a town of Achilles’ realm; acc. sg. Τρηχῖνα (stem Τρηχῖν-)
